explanation.en: LORD in small capitals represents God's covenant name, by which he revealed himself to Israel. In Exodus 3:15 God sends Moses to Israel and declares this name to be remembered through all generations.
explanation.zh: 英文圣经中的全大写 LORD 代表上帝向以色列启示的盟约之名。出埃及记3:15记载上帝差遣摩西，并宣告这名要世世代代被记念。

sampleVerse.text: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.

explanation.en: Israel is the new name God gave Jacob and later the name of the people descended from him. Genesis 32:28 connects the name with Jacob's struggle and his prevailing with God and men.
explanation.zh: 以色列是上帝赐给雅各的新名，后来也成为他后裔民族的名称。创世记32:28把这名字与雅各的摔跤，以及他在上帝和人面前得胜的经历联系起来。

sampleVerse.text: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

explanation.en: A king exercises rule and bears responsibility for a people, while Scripture presents God as the supreme ruler. Psalm 47:7 calls God King of all the earth and invites his people to praise him with understanding.
explanation.zh: 君王治理百姓，也为所治理的人承担责任；圣经则宣告上帝是至高的统治者。诗篇47:7称上帝为全地的王，并呼召人以悟性歌颂祂。

sampleVerse.text: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.

explanation.en: House can mean a dwelling or the family and household who live under one shared allegiance. In Joshua 24:15 Joshua commits both himself and his house to serving the LORD.
explanation.zh: House 既可指房屋，也可指同属一个家庭、共同生活的人。约书亚记24:15中，约书亚宣告自己和全家都要事奉耶和华。

sampleVerse.text: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

explanation.en: David was a shepherd who became Israel's king and the ancestor of the promised Messiah. In 1 Samuel 17:50 he defeats Goliath with a sling and stone, showing that Israel's deliverance came through trust in God rather than superior weapons.
explanation.zh: 大卫原是牧羊人，后来成为以色列王，也是应许中弥赛亚的先祖。撒母耳记上17:50记载他用机弦和石子击败歌利亚，显明以色列的拯救来自对上帝的信靠，而非武器上的优势。

sampleVerse.text: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.

explanation.en: Moses was the leader God called to bring Israel out of slavery and to receive his covenant law. In Exodus 3:10 God commissions him to confront Pharaoh and lead the Israelites out of Egypt.
explanation.zh: 摩西是上帝呼召来带领以色列脱离奴役、并领受盟约律法的领袖。出埃及记3:10记载上帝差遣他面对法老，把以色列人从埃及领出来。

sampleVerse.text: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.

explanation.en: The hand often represents a person's actions, power, or responsibility in biblical language. Psalm 24:4 joins clean hands with a pure heart, teaching that outward conduct and inward character belong together.
explanation.zh: 在圣经语言中，手常代表人的行为、能力或责任。诗篇24:4把清洁的手与清洁的心并列，说明外在行为与内在品格不可分割。

sampleVerse.text: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

explanation.en: Egypt was the Nile kingdom where Joseph preserved his family and where their descendants were later enslaved. Exodus 12:41 marks Israel's departure after 430 years, making Egypt central to the story of the Exodus and divine deliverance.
explanation.zh: 埃及是尼罗河流域的古国；约瑟曾在那里保全家族，他的后裔后来却沦为奴隶。出埃及记12:41记载以色列人在四百三十年后离开，使埃及成为出埃及与上帝拯救故事的核心地点。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.

explanation.en: Father can name a male parent or ancestor, and Jesus especially uses it for God's caring authority and relationship to his people. In Matthew 6:9 Jesus teaches his disciples to address God as their Father in heaven and to honor his name.
explanation.zh: 父亲可以指男性家长或祖先；耶稣更用这个称呼表达上帝慈爱的权柄，以及祂与百姓的关系。马太福音6:9中，耶稣教导门徒称上帝为天父，并尊祂的名为圣。

sampleVerse.text: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

explanation.en: Earth may mean the ground, the inhabited world, or the whole created realm in contrast with heaven. Genesis 1:1 begins the biblical story by declaring that God created both heaven and earth.
explanation.zh: Earth 可指土地、人所居住的世界，或与天相对的整个受造领域。创世记1:1以宣告上帝创造天地，开启了整部圣经的叙事。

sampleVerse.text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

explanation.en: Jesus is the personal name of the Messiah, the Son of God who became human to save. Matthew 1:21 gives the child this name because he would save his people from their sins.
explanation.zh: 耶稣是弥赛亚的名字；祂是成为人的上帝之子，为要施行拯救。马太福音1:21说明孩子要取这名，因为祂要把自己的百姓从罪恶中救出来。

sampleVerse.text: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

explanation.en: A city is a settled community whose walls, homes, and institutions gather many people in one place. Genesis 4:17 records Cain building the first named city, showing urban life beginning even within humanity's troubled history.
explanation.zh: 城市是许多人聚居的定居群体，包含房屋、防御和共同制度。创世记4:17记载该隐建造圣经中最早被提及的城，显示人类虽处在罪的历史中，城市生活也已开始。

sampleVerse.text: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.

explanation.en: The heart in Scripture is the inner center of thought, desire, choice, and character rather than emotion alone. Proverbs 4:23 urges careful guardianship of the heart because the course of life flows from it.
explanation.zh: 圣经中的心不只代表情绪，更是思想、愿望、选择和品格的内在中心。箴言4:23吩咐人谨守自己的心，因为一生的果效都由心发出。

sampleVerse.text: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

explanation.en: Judah was Jacob and Leah's fourth son, and his tribe later became the royal line of David and Jesus. Genesis 29:35 records Leah praising the LORD at his birth and naming him Judah, a name associated with praise.
explanation.zh: 犹大是雅各和利亚的第四个儿子，他的支派后来成为大卫和耶稣所属的君王谱系。创世记29:35记载利亚因他的出生赞美耶和华，并为他取名犹大，这名字与赞美有关。

sampleVerse.text: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.

explanation.en: Saul son of Kish was Israel's first king, whose promising beginning was later undone by persistent disobedience. In 1 Samuel 10:1 Samuel anoints him and declares that the LORD has appointed him over Israel.
explanation.zh: 基士的儿子扫罗是以色列第一位君王；他起初前景良好，后来却因持续悖逆而失败。撒母耳记上10:1记载撒母耳膏立他，宣告耶和华已使他治理以色列。

sampleVerse.text: Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him, and said, Is it not because the LORD hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance?

explanation.en: Aaron was Moses' brother and the first high priest of Israel's hereditary priesthood. Exodus 28:1 sets him and his sons apart to minister as priests, linking his family with the sanctuary service.
explanation.zh: 亚伦是摩西的哥哥，也是以色列世袭祭司制度中的第一位大祭司。出埃及记28:1把他和众子分别出来担任祭司，使他的家族与圣所事奉相连。

sampleVerse.text: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.

explanation.en: A mine is a place where people dig beneath the earth for metal or precious material. Job 28:1 introduces a poem about human skill in finding silver and refining gold, before contrasting it with wisdom that only God fully knows.
explanation.zh: 矿是人深入地下开采金属或珍贵材料的地方。约伯记28:1以寻找银矿、炼取黄金开始一首论智慧的诗，随后指出真正的智慧只有上帝完全知道。

sampleVerse.text: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.

explanation.en: Heaven can describe the sky and stars or the realm of God's throne and rule. Genesis 1:1 declares heaven and earth to be God's creation, so neither exists independently of him.
explanation.zh: 天可以指天空和星辰，也可指上帝宝座与统治所在的领域。创世记1:1宣告天地都是上帝所创造的，因此没有一方能脱离祂而独立存在。

sampleVerse.text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

explanation.en: Solomon was David's son, Israel's king, and builder of the first temple in Jerusalem. In 1 Kings 3:12 God grants the understanding heart Solomon requested, establishing his reputation for exceptional wisdom.
explanation.zh: 所罗门是大卫的儿子、以色列王，也是耶路撒冷第一圣殿的建造者。列王纪上3:12记载上帝赐给他所求的聪明智慧，使他以非凡智慧闻名。

sampleVerse.text: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.

explanation.en: Christ means Anointed One and is the Greek title corresponding to Messiah, not Jesus' surname. In Matthew 16:16 Peter confesses Jesus as the Christ and the Son of the living God.
explanation.zh: Christ 意为“受膏者”，是与“弥赛亚”相对应的希腊语称号，并不是耶稣的姓氏。马太福音16:16中，彼得承认耶稣是基督、是永生上帝的儿子。

sampleVerse.text: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

explanation.en: Babylon was the Mesopotamian empire that conquered Judah, destroyed Jerusalem, and carried many people into exile. Second Kings 25:9 records its forces burning the temple and major buildings, a defining catastrophe in Judah's history.
explanation.zh: 巴比伦是征服犹大、毁坏耶路撒冷并掳走许多百姓的美索不达米亚帝国。列王纪下25:9记载巴比伦军焚烧圣殿和城中重要建筑，成为犹大历史上的重大灾难。

sampleVerse.text: And he burnt the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man's house burnt he with fire.

explanation.en: Fire gives light and heat but can also consume, so Scripture uses it for God's presence, purification, and judgment. In Exodus 3:2 the angel of the LORD appears to Moses in a burning bush that is not consumed.
explanation.zh: 火能发光发热，也能焚烧，因此圣经用它表达上帝的同在、炼净和审判。出埃及记3:2记载耶和华的使者在燃烧却没有烧毁的荆棘中向摩西显现。

sampleVerse.text: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

explanation.en: A priest is appointed to represent people before God and to offer gifts and sacrifices. Hebrews 5:1 describes this mediating office, which the New Testament ultimately sets beneath the perfect high-priestly ministry of Christ.
explanation.zh: 祭司受命在上帝面前代表百姓，并献上礼物和祭物。希伯来书5:1说明这种居间职分；新约最终把它指向基督完全的大祭司事工。

sampleVerse.text: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

explanation.en: Abraham was called from his homeland to become the ancestor of Israel and a channel of blessing to the nations. Genesis 12:2 promises to make him a great nation, bless him, and make his name great.
explanation.zh: 亚伯拉罕蒙召离开故乡，成为以色列的先祖，并成为万国得福的渠道。创世记12:2应许使他成为大国、赐福给他，并使他的名为大。

sampleVerse.text: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

explanation.en: Spirit can mean breath or inner life, while the Holy Spirit is the divine Person active in creation, revelation, and renewal. Genesis 1:2 places the Spirit of God over the waters at the beginning of creation.
explanation.zh: 灵可以指气息或内在生命；圣灵则是参与创造、启示和更新的神圣位格。创世记1:2在创造开始时描写上帝的灵运行在水面上。

sampleVerse.text: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

explanation.en: Seven often marks a complete cycle in Scripture, especially the seven-day week established at creation. Genesis 2:2 says God completed his work by the seventh day and rested, forming the basis of the seventh-day Sabbath.
explanation.zh: 七在圣经中常表示一个完整周期，尤其见于创造时设立的七日一周。创世记2:2说上帝在第七日完成创造并安息，成为第七日安息日的基础。

sampleVerse.text: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

explanation.en: Life includes created existence and the eternal, restored life that comes from God through Christ. John 1:4 declares that life is in the Word and that this life is the light of humanity.
explanation.zh: 生命既包括受造的生存，也包括上帝借基督赐下、更新而永恒的生命。约翰福音1:4宣告生命在“道”里面，这生命就是人的光。

sampleVerse.text: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

explanation.en: Blood represents the life of a creature and therefore holds a central place in biblical sacrifice and atonement. Leviticus 17:11 says the life is in the blood and that God gave it upon the altar to make atonement.
explanation.zh: 血代表活物的生命，因此在圣经的献祭与赎罪制度中占有核心地位。利未记17:11说生命在血中，上帝把血赐在坛上为人赎罪。

sampleVerse.text: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

explanation.en: A sword is a bladed weapon and also a biblical image for war, judgment, and penetrating speech. Hebrews 4:12 compares God's living word to a two-edged sword that discerns the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
explanation.zh: 剑是有刃的武器，在圣经中也象征战争、审判和能穿透人心的话语。希伯来书4:12把上帝活泼的话比作两刃的剑，能够辨明人心中的思想和动机。

sampleVerse.text: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

explanation.en: Flesh can mean the physical body, mortal humanity, or human weakness, depending on context. John 1:14 declares that the eternal Word became flesh and lived among humanity, affirming Christ's real incarnation.
explanation.zh: Flesh 可按上下文指肉身、必死的人类或人的软弱。约翰福音1:14宣告永恒的道成了肉身、住在人间，确认基督真实地成为人。

sampleVerse.text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

explanation.en: Gold was valued for beauty and durability and was widely used in the tabernacle and temple. Exodus 25:11 commands that the ark be overlaid inside and outside with pure gold, marking the holiness of its sanctuary setting.
explanation.zh: 黄金因美丽和耐久而珍贵，也广泛用于会幕和圣殿。出埃及记25:11吩咐约柜内外都包上精金，显出它所在圣所的神圣。

sampleVerse.text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.

explanation.en: Face often means a person's visible presence, attention, or favor rather than appearance alone. Numbers 6:25 asks the LORD to make his face shine upon his people, a picture of gracious divine favor.
explanation.zh: 脸在圣经中常不只指外貌，也表示一个人的临在、关注或恩宠。民数记6:25祈求耶和华使祂的脸光照百姓，以此描绘上帝恩慈的眷顾。

sampleVerse.text: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

explanation.en: Joshua son of Nun succeeded Moses and led Israel across the Jordan into Canaan. Joshua 1:2 records God's commission for him to arise and lead the people into the promised land.
explanation.zh: 嫩的儿子约书亚接续摩西，带领以色列人过约旦河进入迦南。约书亚记1:2记载上帝委任他起来，带领百姓进入应许之地。

sampleVerse.text: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.

explanation.en: A wife is a woman joined to her husband in the covenant companionship of marriage. Genesis 2:24 describes husband and wife leaving prior households, cleaving to one another, and becoming one flesh.
explanation.zh: 妻子是在婚姻盟约中与丈夫结合、彼此陪伴的女子。创世记2:24描述夫妻离开原来的家庭，彼此联合，成为一体。

sampleVerse.text: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

explanation.en: Brother primarily means a male sibling but can also describe a relative, countryman, or fellow believer. In Genesis 4:9 Cain's evasive question after killing Abel exposes the human duty to care for one's brother.
explanation.zh: Brother 首先指男性手足，也可指亲属、同胞或同信的人。创世记4:9中，该隐杀害亚伯后逃避责任的反问，反而揭示人有看顾弟兄的义务。

sampleVerse.text: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?

explanation.en: Glory describes honor and splendor and, above all, the awe-inspiring manifestation of God's character and presence. In Exodus 33:18 Moses asks God to show him his glory, leading to a revelation of God's goodness and name.
explanation.zh: 荣耀表示尊荣和光辉，尤其指上帝品格与同在令人敬畏的彰显。出埃及记33:18中，摩西求上帝显出荣耀，随后得以认识祂的良善和圣名。

sampleVerse.text: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

explanation.en: Jacob was the younger son of Isaac and Rebekah and the father of the twelve tribal ancestors of Israel. Genesis 32:28 records his renaming as Israel after a night of wrestling, marking a turning point in his life.
explanation.zh: 雅各是以撒和利百加的小儿子，也是以色列十二支派先祖的父亲。创世记32:28记载他经过一夜摔跤后被改名为以色列，成为人生的重要转折。

sampleVerse.text: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

explanation.en: An altar is a raised place where offerings or sacrifices are presented to God. In Genesis 22:9 Abraham builds an altar and binds Isaac upon it, immediately before God provides a substitute sacrifice.
explanation.zh: 祭坛是向上帝献上供物或祭物的地方。创世记22:9记载亚伯拉罕筑坛并把以撒绑在其上，随后上帝亲自预备了代替的祭牲。

sampleVerse.text: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

explanation.en: The Jordan is the principal river running through the biblical land from north to the Dead Sea. Joshua 3:17 records Israel crossing its dry bed under Joshua, marking their entrance into Canaan.
explanation.zh: 约旦河是贯穿圣经地区、由北流向死海的主要河流。约书亚记3:17记载以色列人在约书亚带领下走过干涸的河床，标志他们进入迦南。

sampleVerse.text: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

explanation.en: Death ends a person's active participation in life under the sun, and Scripture often compares it to sleep while looking toward resurrection. Ecclesiastes 9:5 contrasts the awareness of the living with the dead, who no longer know or share in what happens in this present life.
explanation.zh: 死亡使人不再参与日光之下的今世生活；圣经也常把它比作睡眠，同时指向将来的复活。传道书9:5把活人的知觉与死人相对照，说明死者不再知道或参与现今世上的事。

sampleVerse.text: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.

explanation.en: Drink sustains physical life, while Scripture also uses thirst and water for spiritual need and divine provision. In John 4:14 Jesus promises living water that becomes a spring leading to everlasting life.
explanation.zh: 饮水维持肉身生命；圣经也以干渴和水表达属灵需要与上帝的供应。约翰福音4:14中，耶稣应许赐下活水，在人里面成为泉源，直涌到永生。

sampleVerse.text: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

explanation.en: Paul was once a persecutor of Christians but became an apostle and missionary after encountering the risen Jesus. Acts 9:15 calls him a chosen instrument to carry Christ's name before Gentiles, kings, and Israel.
explanation.zh: 保罗原先逼迫基督徒，遇见复活的耶稣后却成为使徒和宣教士。使徒行传9:15称他为蒙拣选的器皿，要在外邦人、君王和以色列人面前传扬基督的名。

sampleVerse.text: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:

explanation.en: A year orders seasons, agriculture, festivals, and communal memory in the biblical calendar. Leviticus 25:10 sets apart the fiftieth year as Jubilee, when liberty was proclaimed and inherited property restored.
explanation.zh: 年在圣经历法中安排季节、农耕、节期和群体记忆。利未记25:10把第五十年分别为禧年，届时要宣告自由，并归还祖传产业。

sampleVerse.text: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

explanation.en: Woman names the female human being, created with man in God's image and as his corresponding companion. Genesis 2:23 records the man's recognition that the woman shares his own bone and flesh.
explanation.zh: 女人指女性的人，与男人同按上帝形象受造，并成为与他相配的伴侣。创世记2:23记载男人承认女人与自己同骨同肉。

sampleVerse.text: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

explanation.en: Bread was the ordinary staple of biblical households and a basic sign of God's provision. In John 6:35 Jesus calls himself the bread of life, promising lasting satisfaction to those who come to and believe in him.
explanation.zh: 饼是圣经时代家庭的日常主食，也是上帝供应的基本记号。约翰福音6:35中，耶稣称自己为生命的粮，应许使到祂这里并信祂的人得到长久满足。

sampleVerse.text: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

explanation.en: To dwell is to live or remain in a place, and Scripture uses the idea especially for God's presence among his people. Exodus 25:8 commands Israel to make a sanctuary so that God may dwell among them.
explanation.zh: 居住就是在一处生活或长久停留；圣经尤其用这个概念表达上帝在百姓中间的同在。出埃及记25:8吩咐以色列建造圣所，使上帝可以住在他们中间。

sampleVerse.text: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

explanation.en: Ephraim was Joseph's younger son, whose descendants became a leading tribe and later a name for the northern kingdom. Genesis 48:20 records Jacob placing Ephraim before Manasseh in his blessing, despite his younger birth order.
explanation.zh: 以法莲是约瑟的小儿子；他的后裔成为重要支派，后来这个名字也代表北国。创世记48:20记载雅各祝福时把以法莲置于哥哥玛拿西之前，虽然后者才是长子。

sampleVerse.text: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

explanation.en: Silver served as precious metal, sanctuary material, and a measured medium of payment before coined money. Genesis 23:16 records Abraham weighing silver to Ephron to purchase the burial field at Machpelah.
explanation.zh: 银既是贵金属和圣所材料，也在铸币出现前按重量用作付款媒介。创世记23:16记载亚伯拉罕称银子给以弗仑，买下麦比拉的坟地。

sampleVerse.text: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.

explanation.en: Moab was the nation east of the Dead Sea descended from Lot's older daughter, often in conflict with Israel. Ruth 1:22 identifies Ruth as a Moabitess who returned with Naomi to Bethlehem, beginning a story in which an outsider enters David's family line.
explanation.zh: 摩押是死海以东、源自罗得大女儿后裔的民族，常与以色列发生冲突。路得记1:22称路得为摩押女子；她随拿俄米回到伯利恒，由此开始一个外族女子进入大卫家谱的故事。

sampleVerse.text: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

explanation.en: Biblical love seeks another's good through loyal, self-giving action rather than sentiment alone. In John 13:34 Jesus commands his disciples to love one another according to the pattern of his own love for them.
explanation.zh: 圣经中的爱不只是感情，而是以忠诚和舍己的行动寻求他人的益处。约翰福音13:34中，耶稣吩咐门徒照着祂爱他们的榜样彼此相爱。

sampleVerse.text: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

explanation.en: A field is open land used for crops or grazing and often becomes the setting of biblical parables. In Matthew 13:38 Jesus explains that the field in the parable of the wheat and tares represents the world.
explanation.zh: 田地是用于耕种或放牧的开阔土地，也常成为圣经比喻的场景。马太福音13:38中，耶稣解释麦子与稗子比喻里的田地代表世界。

sampleVerse.text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;

explanation.en: Zion first named the Jebusite stronghold in Jerusalem and later represented the holy city and God's reign among his people. Second Samuel 5:7 records David capturing the stronghold and making it the city of David.
explanation.zh: 锡安起初指耶路撒冷的耶布斯堡垒，后来代表圣城和上帝在百姓中的统治。撒母耳记下5:7记载大卫攻取这座保障，使它成为大卫城。

sampleVerse.text: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.

explanation.en: Pharaoh was the royal title of Egypt's kings rather than one ruler's personal name. In Exodus 5:2 the Pharaoh of the Exodus rejects Moses' demand and claims not to know the LORD, setting up the conflict displayed in the plagues.
explanation.zh: 法老是埃及君王的王号，并非某一位统治者的私人名字。出埃及记5:2中，出埃及时期的法老拒绝摩西的要求，并声称不认识耶和华，由此引出十灾中的权柄冲突。

sampleVerse.text: And Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.

explanation.en: Mercy is compassionate faithfulness shown to the guilty, suffering, or helpless without denying justice. Exodus 34:6 places mercy and grace at the center of God's own proclamation of his character.
explanation.zh: 怜悯是在不否定公义的前提下，向有罪、受苦或无助之人施行慈爱与信实。出埃及记34:6中，上帝亲自宣告自己的品格，把怜悯和恩典置于核心。

sampleVerse.text: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

explanation.en: A city gate was an entrance, gathering place, and public court where elders witnessed legal business. Ruth 4:1 places Boaz at Bethlehem's gate to settle the right of redemption openly before the community.
explanation.zh: 城门既是出入口，也是众人聚集、长老见证法律事务的公共场所。路得记4:1记载波阿斯坐在伯利恒城门口，要在众人面前公开处理赎业权。

sampleVerse.text: Then went Boaz up to the gate, and sat him down there: and, behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said, Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.

explanation.en: Rest includes relief from labor and the deeper repose of trusting God's completed saving work. Hebrews 4:9 says a Sabbath rest remains for God's people, linking present faith and obedience with God's promised rest.
explanation.zh: 安息既包括停止劳作，也包括信靠上帝已经成就之救恩的深层安稳。希伯来书4:9说仍有安息日的安息为上帝的百姓存留，把当下的信靠与顺服连于祂所应许的安息。

sampleVerse.text: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

explanation.en: Light is a biblical image of creation, truth, holiness, guidance, and God's life-giving presence. John 1:4 says the life in the Word was humanity's light, joining spiritual illumination directly to Christ.
explanation.zh: 光在圣经中象征创造、真理、圣洁、引导，以及上帝赐生命的同在。约翰福音1:4说“道”里面的生命就是人的光，把属灵光照直接连于基督。

sampleVerse.text: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

explanation.en: Samuel was dedicated to God as a child and later served Israel as prophet, judge, and kingmaker. In 1 Samuel 3:10 he answers God's nighttime call, beginning his recognized prophetic ministry.
explanation.zh: 撒母耳自幼被献给上帝，后来作以色列的先知、士师，并膏立君王。撒母耳记上3:10记载他在夜间回应上帝的呼唤，由此开始被公认的先知职事。

sampleVerse.text: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

explanation.en: Joab, David's nephew through Zeruiah, commanded David's army and was both effective and ruthlessly violent. Second Samuel 8:16 names him over the host during David's reign, identifying the authority behind many later military and political actions.
explanation.zh: 约押是大卫姐姐洗鲁雅的儿子，统领大卫军队；他办事有力，却也屡次残酷行事。撒母耳记下8:16称他为元帅，说明他在后来许多军事和政治事件中拥有的权力。

sampleVerse.text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

explanation.en: A well is a deep man-made shaft that reaches groundwater, vital to settlements in a dry land. John 4:6 locates Jesus at Jacob's well, where his request for water opens a conversation about living water with a Samaritan woman.
explanation.zh: 井是人工深挖以取得地下水的设施，在干旱地区对聚落十分重要。约翰福音4:6记载耶稣坐在雅各井旁；祂从求水开始，与撒玛利亚妇人谈论活水。

sampleVerse.text: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

explanation.en: Mount is an older or formal word for a mountain and frequently forms part of biblical place names. Exodus 19:20 records the LORD descending upon Mount Sinai and calling Moses upward, making the mountain the setting for Israel's covenant.
explanation.zh: Mount 是“山”的古典或正式说法，也常出现在圣经地名中。出埃及记19:20记载耶和华降临西奈山并召摩西上山，使这座山成为以色列立约的场所。

sampleVerse.text: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

explanation.en: Isaac was the promised son born to Abraham and Sarah in their old age, and his name means laughter. Genesis 21:3 records Abraham naming the child Isaac after God fulfilled the long-delayed promise.
explanation.zh: 以撒是亚伯拉罕和撒拉年老时所得的应许之子，他的名字意为“喜笑”。创世记21:3记载上帝实现久候的应许后，亚伯拉罕给孩子取名以撒。

sampleVerse.text: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

explanation.en: Joseph was Jacob's son who was sold into Egypt, rose to authority, and preserved his family during famine. Genesis 50:20 interprets his story by contrasting his brothers' evil intention with God's purpose to save many lives.
explanation.zh: 约瑟是雅各的儿子，被卖到埃及后升居高位，并在饥荒中保全家族。创世记50:20以弟兄的恶意对比上帝拯救多人性命的旨意，概括了他的经历。

sampleVerse.text: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

explanation.en: Biblical months followed the lunar cycle and organized Israel's festivals and agricultural life. Exodus 12:2 makes the month of the Passover the beginning of Israel's religious year, ordering time around deliverance from Egypt.
explanation.zh: 圣经中的月份按月亮周期计算，用来安排以色列的节期和农耕生活。出埃及记12:2把逾越节所在之月定为宗教年的正月，使时间围绕出埃及的拯救来排列。

sampleVerse.text: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.

explanation.en: A prophet is called to deliver God's message faithfully rather than merely predict the future. Deuteronomy 18:18 promises a prophet who will speak God's words, a promise ultimately fulfilled in Christ and reflected in the prophetic office.
explanation.zh: 先知蒙召忠实传达上帝的信息，并不只是预告未来。申命记18:18应许一位口中有上帝话语的先知；这应许最终在基督里成全，也显明先知职分的本质。

sampleVerse.text: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.

explanation.en: Faith is trusting reliance on God and his promises that produces faithful action. Hebrews 11:1 describes it as confidence in what is hoped for and conviction concerning realities not yet seen.
explanation.zh: 信心是对上帝及其应许的信靠，并由此产生忠诚的行动。希伯来书11:1把信心描述为所望之事的实底，以及对尚未看见之事的确据。

sampleVerse.text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

explanation.en: A tribe is a large kinship group descended from a common ancestor; Israel's twelve tribes came from Jacob's sons. Genesis 49:28 gathers these sons under the name of the twelve tribes and records their father's distinct blessings.
explanation.zh: 支派是源自共同祖先的大型亲族群体；以色列十二支派出自雅各的众子。创世记49:28把这些儿子统称为十二支派，并记下父亲按各人所得的祝福。

sampleVerse.text: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

explanation.en: Samaria was the hill-city Omri built as the capital of the northern kingdom of Israel and later the name of its surrounding region. First Kings 16:24 records Omri purchasing the hill from Shemer and naming the new city after him.
explanation.zh: 撒玛利亚是暗利建造、作为北国以色列首都的山城，后来也指其周围地区。列王纪上16:24记载暗利从示玛买下山地，并以原主之名为新城命名。

sampleVerse.text: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.

explanation.en: Truth is what accords with God's character and reality, expressed through faithfulness and opposed to falsehood. In John 17:17 Jesus identifies God's word as truth and asks the Father to sanctify his disciples through it.
explanation.zh: 真理是与上帝品格和真实相符的事，也表现为信实，与虚假相对。约翰福音17:17中，耶稣称上帝的道为真理，并求父借真理使门徒成圣。

sampleVerse.text: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

explanation.en: A biblical book was first a written scroll used to preserve laws, histories, prophecies, and letters. Jeremiah 36:2 commands the prophet to write God's messages on a roll, showing how spoken revelation was preserved for later hearers.
explanation.zh: 圣经时代的书起初多是卷轴，用来保存律法、历史、预言和书信。耶利米书36:2吩咐先知把上帝的信息写在书卷上，显示口传启示如何留给后来的听众。

sampleVerse.text: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day.

explanation.en: Anger is a response to perceived wrong that may be justly aroused but easily becomes sinful when nursed or misdirected. Ephesians 4:26 warns believers not to let anger lead into sin or remain unresolved.
explanation.zh: 愤怒是人面对所认定之错误时的反应；它可能出于正当原因，却很容易因积压或错置而成为罪。以弗所书4:26警告信徒不可让怒气引向犯罪，也不可长期不处理。

sampleVerse.text: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:

explanation.en: Assyria was the powerful northern Mesopotamian empire that conquered the kingdom of Israel. Second Kings 18:11 records the Assyrian king deporting Israelites, marking the end of the northern kingdom and the beginning of exile.
explanation.zh: 亚述是美索不达米亚北部的强大帝国，曾征服以色列北国。列王纪下18:11记载亚述王掳走以色列人，标志北国灭亡和被掳生活的开始。

sampleVerse.text: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:

explanation.en: Wine is grape juice in various stages of preparation, and biblical passages may associate it with celebration or warn against intoxication. Hosea 4:11 warns that wine and sexual unfaithfulness take away sound judgment, emphasizing the danger of appetite ruling the heart.
explanation.zh: 酒是处于不同制作阶段的葡萄汁；圣经有时把它与宴乐相连，也警告醉酒的危害。何西阿书4:11警告酒与淫乱会夺去人的心，强调让欲望支配判断的危险。

sampleVerse.text: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.

explanation.en: The bear of the biblical lands was a powerful wild animal capable of attacking livestock and people. In 1 Samuel 17:34 David recalls defending his father's flock from a lion and a bear, experience that prepared him to face Goliath.
explanation.zh: 圣经地区的熊是强壮的野兽，能够袭击牲畜和人。撒母耳记上17:34中，大卫回忆自己保护父亲羊群、击退狮子和熊的经历；这也预备他面对歌利亚。

sampleVerse.text: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father's sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:

explanation.en: Fruit means a plant's produce and figuratively the visible outcome of character, teaching, or conduct. Galatians 5:22 begins the list of the Spirit's fruit, presenting love, joy, peace, and related qualities as results of his work in a life.
explanation.zh: 果子既指植物的出产，也比喻品格、教导或行为所结出的可见结果。加拉太书5:22开始列举圣灵的果子，把仁爱、喜乐、和平等品格视为圣灵在人生命中工作的成果。

sampleVerse.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

explanation.en: A child is a young person dependent on the care and instruction of others, yet fully valued by God. In Mark 10:14 Jesus welcomes children whom the disciples tried to turn away and says God's kingdom belongs to such as these.
explanation.zh: 孩子是需要他人照顾和教导的年幼者，却在上帝眼中具有完整价值。马可福音10:14中，耶稣接纳被门徒阻拦的孩子，并说上帝的国属于像他们这样的人。

sampleVerse.text: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

explanation.en: The poor are people lacking adequate resources or social protection, toward whom biblical law requires practical justice. Leviticus 19:10 commands landowners to leave gleanings for the poor and the stranger rather than harvesting everything for themselves.
explanation.zh: 穷人是缺乏足够资源或社会保障的人；圣经律法要求人以实际行动维护他们的公义。利未记19:10吩咐地主留下田间余粮给穷人和寄居者，不可把收成全部据为己有。

sampleVerse.text: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God.

explanation.en: The temple in Jerusalem became Israel's central house of worship and sacrifice, replacing the portable tabernacle. First Kings 6:1 dates the beginning of Solomon's construction, connecting the sanctuary with Israel's deliverance from Egypt.
explanation.zh: 耶路撒冷圣殿取代可移动的会幕，成为以色列敬拜和献祭的中心。列王纪上6:1记下所罗门开工的时间，并把圣所的建造与以色列出埃及的拯救相连。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.

explanation.en: An angel is a messenger sent by God to announce or carry out his purposes. Luke 1:26 records Gabriel being sent to Nazareth, where he would announce to Mary the birth of Jesus.
explanation.zh: 天使是上帝差遣来宣告或执行祂旨意的使者。路加福音1:26记载加百列奉差往拿撒勒，要向马利亚宣告耶稣的降生。

sampleVerse.text: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

explanation.en: Absalom was David's handsome and ambitious son who avenged his sister Tamar and later rebelled against his father. Second Samuel 15:10 records his secret signal proclaiming himself king, turning family conflict into civil war.
explanation.zh: 押沙龙是大卫俊美而有野心的儿子；他为妹妹她玛报仇，后来又背叛父亲。撒母耳记下15:10记载他暗中发出自立为王的信号，使家庭冲突演变为内战。

sampleVerse.text: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.

explanation.en: Gilead was the fertile highland east of the Jordan, later occupied chiefly by Reuben, Gad, and part of Manasseh. Numbers 32:1 notes its suitability for livestock, which led Reuben and Gad to request land there.
explanation.zh: 基列是约旦河东肥沃的高地，后来主要由流便、迦得和玛拿西半支派居住。民数记32:1指出那里适合牧养牲畜，因此流便和迦得请求得那地为业。

sampleVerse.text: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;

explanation.en: Canaan was both a son of Ham and, more commonly, the land promised to Abraham's descendants. Genesis 12:5 records Abram entering that land in obedience to God's call, beginning the patriarchal story there.
explanation.zh: 迦南既是含的一个儿子，更常指上帝应许给亚伯拉罕后裔的土地。创世记12:5记载亚伯兰顺从呼召进入那地，由此展开先祖在迦南的故事。

sampleVerse.text: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

explanation.en: Ahab son of Omri was king of northern Israel and, under Jezebel's influence, promoted Baal worship. First Kings 16:30 judges him as doing more evil than the kings before him, preparing for Elijah's confrontation with his rule.
explanation.zh: 暗利的儿子亚哈是北国以色列王，在耶洗别影响下推动巴力崇拜。列王纪上16:30评价他行恶超过从前诸王，为以利亚后来与其政权对抗作了铺垫。

sampleVerse.text: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that were before him.

explanation.en: Edom, meaning red, became another name for Esau and for the nation descended from him southeast of Israel. Genesis 25:30 connects the name with Esau's demand for Jacob's red stew, in the episode where he sold his birthright.
explanation.zh: 以东意为“红”，后来成为以扫及其后裔在以色列东南方所建民族的名称。创世记25:30把这名字与以扫向雅各索取红汤相连；在这件事中，他卖掉了长子的名分。

sampleVerse.text: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

explanation.en: Elijah was a prophet in northern Israel who opposed Ahab's Baal worship and called the people back to the LORD. In 1 Kings 18:21 he challenges Israel on Mount Carmel to stop wavering and choose whom they will serve.
explanation.zh: 以利亚是北国以色列的先知，反对亚哈推动的巴力崇拜，并呼召百姓归回耶和华。列王纪上18:21中，他在迦密山挑战以色列人不要再摇摆，而要选择所事奉的主。

sampleVerse.text: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

explanation.en: Daniel was a Jewish exile who served foreign rulers without abandoning loyalty to God. Daniel 6:22 says God sent an angel to shut the lions' mouths, vindicating Daniel after his faithful prayer led to persecution.
explanation.zh: 但以理是被掳的犹太人；他在外邦君王手下任职，却没有放弃对上帝的忠诚。但以理书6:22说上帝差遣使者封住狮子的口，使因忠心祷告而受迫害的但以理得到伸冤。

sampleVerse.text: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.

explanation.en: Reuben was Jacob and Leah's firstborn son and ancestor of one of Israel's twelve tribes. Genesis 29:32 records Leah naming him after recognizing that the LORD had seen her affliction.
explanation.zh: 流便是雅各和利亚的长子，也是以色列十二支派之一的先祖。创世记29:32记载利亚因承认耶和华看见她的苦情，而给儿子取了这个名字。

sampleVerse.text: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

explanation.en: Syria was the region north of Israel, known in the Old Testament as Aram and containing cities such as Damascus. Galatians 1:21 says Paul later entered the regions of Syria and Cilicia during his early ministry.
explanation.zh: 叙利亚位于以色列北方，旧约常称为亚兰，其中包括大马士革等城市。加拉太书1:21说保罗早期传道时后来到了叙利亚和基利家一带。

sampleVerse.text: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

explanation.en: Eleazar was Aaron's third son and succeeded him as Israel's high priest after the deaths of his older brothers. Numbers 20:28 records Moses placing Aaron's priestly garments on Eleazar at Mount Hor, publicly transferring the office.
explanation.zh: 以利亚撒是亚伦的第三个儿子；两位兄长死后，他继任以色列的大祭司。民数记20:28记载摩西在何珥山把亚伦的祭司衣袍穿在以利亚撒身上，公开完成职分交接。

sampleVerse.text: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.

explanation.en: Galilee was the northern region of the land of Israel, around the Sea of Galilee and home to much of Jesus' ministry. Matthew 4:15 identifies its tribal and Gentile setting before describing the light that dawned there through Jesus.
explanation.zh: 加利利是以色列地北部、环绕加利利海的地区，也是耶稣大部分事工展开的地方。马太福音4:15先指出它所属的支派和外邦环境，随后说明光借耶稣在那里照耀。

sampleVerse.text: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;

explanation.en: Hebron was an ancient hill-country city associated with Abraham's family tomb and later David's first capital. Second Samuel 5:3 records Israel's elders anointing David king there before he moved his rule to Jerusalem.
explanation.zh: 希伯仑是古老的山地城，与亚伯拉罕家族的坟地有关，后来也成为大卫最初的首都。撒母耳记下5:3记载以色列长老在那里膏大卫作王，之后他才迁都耶路撒冷。

sampleVerse.text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.

explanation.en: Lebanon is the mountain region north of Israel famed in Scripture for tall and durable cedar trees. First Kings 5:6 records Solomon requesting Lebanese cedar and Sidonian craftsmen for construction of the temple.
explanation.zh: 黎巴嫩是以色列北方的山地，在圣经中以高大耐用的香柏树闻名。列王纪上5:6记载所罗门请求取得黎巴嫩香柏木，并请西顿工匠协助建造圣殿。

sampleVerse.text: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.

explanation.en: Balaam was a non-Israelite diviner hired by Balak to curse Israel, though he could speak only what God permitted. Numbers 22:12 forbids him to curse the people because God has blessed them, establishing the conflict that shapes his story.
explanation.zh: 巴兰是外族术士，被巴勒雇来咒诅以色列，却只能说上帝所许可的话。民数记22:12禁止他咒诅百姓，因为上帝已经赐福给他们，由此确立了整个故事的冲突。

sampleVerse.text: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.

explanation.en: Jericho was a fortified city near the Jordan and the first major city Israel faced after entering Canaan. Joshua 6:20 records its wall falling after the people shouted, presenting the victory as God's act rather than ordinary siege warfare.
explanation.zh: 耶利哥是约旦河附近的坚城，也是以色列进入迦南后面对的第一座重要城市。约书亚记6:20记载百姓呼喊后城墙倒塌，显明胜利来自上帝的作为，而非普通攻城战术。

sampleVerse.text: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

explanation.en: Abner son of Ner was Saul's cousin and commander of Israel's army, later supporting Saul's son Ish-bosheth against David. First Samuel 14:50 identifies both his family connection and military office at the beginning of Saul's reign.
explanation.zh: 尼珥的儿子押尼珥是扫罗的堂兄弟和以色列元帅，后来支持扫罗之子伊施波设与大卫对立。撒母耳记上14:50在扫罗统治早期便说明他的亲属关系和军职。

sampleVerse.text: And the name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.

explanation.en: Baal was the title of a leading Canaanite fertility and storm god whose worship repeatedly drew Israel into idolatry. Judges 2:13 says Israel forsook the LORD to serve Baal and Ashtaroth, explaining the apostasy behind the judges-era oppression.
explanation.zh: 巴力是迦南主要丰收与风暴神明的称号；对他的崇拜屡次引诱以色列陷入偶像崇拜。士师记2:13说以色列离弃耶和华，转而事奉巴力和亚斯她录，说明士师时代受压迫背后的背道。

sampleVerse.text: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.

explanation.en: Bashan was a fertile plateau east of the Jordan ruled by King Og when Israel approached Canaan. Numbers 21:33 records Og marching out against Israel at Edrei, leading to his defeat and Israel's possession of the region.
explanation.zh: 巴珊是约旦河东肥沃的高原；以色列接近迦南时，由噩王统治。民数记21:33记载噩王在以得来出战以色列，结果战败，那地也被以色列取得。

sampleVerse.text: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

explanation.en: Elisha was Elijah's disciple and prophetic successor, serving especially in the northern kingdom. Second Kings 2:15 records the prophetic community recognizing that Elijah's spirit now rested on Elisha after Elijah was taken away.
explanation.zh: 以利沙是以利亚的门徒和先知职分继承者，主要在北国事奉。列王纪下2:15记载以利亚被接去后，先知门徒认出以利亚的灵已经临到以利沙身上。

sampleVerse.text: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

explanation.en: Satan means adversary and names the spiritual enemy who accuses, deceives, and resists God's purposes. Revelation 12:9 identifies him with the devil and ancient serpent and describes his worldwide deception before his final defeat.
explanation.zh: 撒但意为“敌对者”，指控告、欺骗并抵挡上帝旨意的属灵仇敌。启示录12:9把他称为魔鬼和古蛇，描述他迷惑普天下，也预示他终必失败。

sampleVerse.text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

explanation.en: Jehu son of Jehoshaphat was a military commander anointed to replace Ahab's dynasty as king of Israel. Second Kings 9:6 records his secret anointing and commission to rule, beginning his violent purge of Ahab's house and Baal worship.
explanation.zh: 约沙法的儿子耶户原是将领，受膏取代亚哈王朝作以色列王。列王纪下9:6记载他秘密受膏并领受王权，由此开始以暴力清除亚哈家和巴力崇拜。

sampleVerse.text: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the LORD, even over Israel.

explanation.en: Esther was a Jewish orphan who became queen of Persia and risked her life to oppose a plan to destroy her people. Esther 4:14 is Mordecai's challenge that her royal position may have prepared her for precisely this crisis.
explanation.zh: 以斯帖是成为波斯王后的犹太孤女；她冒着生命危险阻止灭绝自己民族的阴谋。以斯帖记4:14记下末底改的提醒：她得到王后的位分，也许正是为了面对这场危机。

sampleVerse.text: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father's house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

explanation.en: Shechem was an ancient city between Mount Ebal and Mount Gerizim, associated with patriarchs, covenant, and tribal gatherings. Joshua 24:1 records Joshua assembling Israel there for a final renewal of loyalty to the LORD.
explanation.zh: 示剑是以巴路山与基利心山之间的古城，与先祖、立约和支派集会密切相关。约书亚记24:1记载约书亚在那里召集以色列，最后一次更新他们对耶和华的忠诚。

sampleVerse.text: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

explanation.en: Josiah became king of Judah as a child and later led a major reform against idolatry. Second Kings 22:11 says he tore his clothes when the neglected book of the law was read, showing repentance before he acted to renew the covenant.
explanation.zh: 约西亚幼年登基作犹大王，后来领导大规模改革，清除偶像崇拜。列王纪下22:11说他听见久被忽略的律法书便撕裂衣服，显出他在更新盟约行动之前先有悔改。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

explanation.en: Laban was Rebekah's brother and the father of Leah and Rachel, for whom Jacob worked in Haran. Genesis 31:7 recalls his repeated changes to Jacob's wages, illustrating the deception and tension that marked their relationship.
explanation.zh: 拉班是利百加的哥哥，也是利亚和拉结的父亲；雅各在哈兰为他工作。创世记31:7回顾他屡次更改雅各的工价，显出两人关系中持续的欺骗与冲突。

sampleVerse.text: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

explanation.en: Noah was the righteous man God instructed to build an ark before the flood. Genesis 6:22 emphasizes that he carried out all God commanded, an obedience through which his household and the animals aboard were preserved.
explanation.zh: 挪亚是上帝在洪水前吩咐建造方舟的义人。创世记6:22强调他照上帝一切命令而行；借着这份顺服，他的家人和方舟中的动物得以保存。

sampleVerse.text: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.

explanation.en: Haman was the Persian king's chief official and an enemy who plotted the destruction of all Jews in the empire. Esther 3:6 shows his wounded pride expanding from hatred of Mordecai into a genocidal plan against an entire people.
explanation.zh: 哈曼是波斯王的高官，也是策划消灭帝国境内所有犹太人的仇敌。以斯帖记3:6显示他的自尊受挫后，怎样把对末底改的仇恨扩大为针对整个民族的灭绝阴谋。

sampleVerse.text: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.

explanation.en: Sodom was a city of the Jordan plain notorious for grave wickedness and violent injustice. Genesis 19:24 records its destruction by fire and brimstone after Lot was rescued, making the city a lasting warning about divine judgment.
explanation.zh: 所多玛是约旦平原的一座城，以严重罪恶和暴力不义闻名。创世记19:24记载罗得获救后，城被硫磺与火毁灭，使所多玛成为上帝审判的长久警戒。

sampleVerse.text: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;

explanation.en: Zadok was a priest loyal to David who later served as high priest under Solomon. First Kings 1:39 records him anointing Solomon king at Gihon, helping secure the intended succession against Adonijah's rival claim.
explanation.zh: 撒督是忠于大卫的祭司，后来在所罗门统治下担任大祭司。列王纪上1:39记载他在基训膏所罗门作王，帮助确立王位继承，挫败亚多尼雅的竞争。

sampleVerse.text: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.

explanation.en: Rachel was Laban's younger daughter, Jacob's beloved wife, and the mother of Joseph and Benjamin. Genesis 30:22 says God remembered her and enabled her to conceive, ending a long period of barrenness before Joseph's birth.
explanation.zh: 拉结是拉班的小女儿、雅各所爱的妻子，也是约瑟和便雅悯的母亲。创世记30:22说上帝顾念她，使她能够怀孕，结束了约瑟出生前漫长的不育时期。

sampleVerse.text: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

explanation.en: Jesse was a Bethlehemite, the grandson of Ruth and Boaz, and the father of David. First Samuel 16:1 sends Samuel to Jesse's household to anoint one of his sons, introducing the family from which Israel's royal line would grow.
explanation.zh: 耶西是伯利恒人、路得和波阿斯的孙子，也是大卫的父亲。撒母耳记上16:1差撒母耳到耶西家中膏立他的一个儿子，由此引出以色列王族的家庭。

sampleVerse.text: And the LORD said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Beth-lehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.

explanation.en: Simeon was Jacob and Leah's second son and the ancestor of an Israelite tribe. Genesis 29:33 connects his name with Leah's conviction that the LORD had heard that she was unloved and had given her another son.
explanation.zh: 西缅是雅各和利亚的第二个儿子，也是以色列一个支派的先祖。创世记29:33把他的名字与利亚的确信相连：耶和华听见她失宠，便又赐给她一个儿子。

sampleVerse.text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.

explanation.en: Gibeah was a Benjaminite hill-town later associated with Saul, but first infamous for an outrage that brought civil war upon the tribe. Judges 20:29 records Israel setting an ambush around the city during the final campaign against Benjamin.
explanation.zh: 基比亚是便雅悯的山城，后来与扫罗有关，却先因一桩暴行引发支派内战而臭名昭著。士师记20:29记载以色列在最后一次攻打便雅悯时，派伏兵环绕这城。

sampleVerse.text: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.

explanation.en: Sarah was Abraham's wife and the mother of Isaac, whose name God changed from Sarai when he confirmed the covenant promise. Genesis 21:2 records her bearing the promised son in old age at the very time God had spoken.
explanation.zh: 撒拉是亚伯拉罕的妻子和以撒的母亲；上帝重申盟约应许时，把她的名字从撒莱改为撒拉。创世记21:2记载她在年老时，按上帝所说的日期生下应许之子。

sampleVerse.text: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

explanation.en: Tyre was a wealthy Phoenician port north of Israel, famous for maritime trade, skilled crafts, and pride. Ezekiel 27:3 addresses the city as a merchant of many coastlands and quotes its boast in perfect beauty before announcing its fall.
explanation.zh: 推罗是以色列北方富有的腓尼基港口，以海上贸易、精湛工艺和骄傲闻名。以西结书27:3称它为众海岛的商埠，并引述它自夸全然美丽，随后宣告其倾覆。

sampleVerse.text: And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I am of perfect beauty.

explanation.en: Gideon was a hesitant judge whom God called to deliver Israel from Midianite oppression. Judges 7:7 reduces his force to three hundred men so that the victory would be recognized as God's deliverance rather than Israel's military strength.
explanation.zh: 基甸是起初犹疑、却蒙上帝呼召来拯救以色列脱离米甸压迫的士师。士师记7:7把他的军队减至三百人，使胜利被认出来自上帝，而不是以色列的军事力量。

sampleVerse.text: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.

explanation.en: Isaiah son of Amoz was a prophet to Judah who announced judgment, comfort, and the hope of God's coming servant and kingdom. Isaiah 6:8 records his willing response, 'Here am I; send me,' after his vision and cleansing.
explanation.zh: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚是向犹大传道的先知，宣告审判、安慰，以及上帝将来仆人与国度的盼望。以赛亚书6:8记载他在异象中得洁净后，甘愿回应：“我在这里，请差遣我。”

sampleVerse.text: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

explanation.en: Asher was Jacob's son by Zilpah and ancestor of the tribe allotted fertile land along Israel's northern coast. Genesis 30:13 records Leah calling herself happy and naming the child Asher, a name associated with blessedness.
explanation.zh: 亚设是雅各借悉帕所生的儿子，也是后来分得以色列北部沿海肥沃土地之支派的先祖。创世记30:13记载利亚称自己有福，并给孩子取名亚设，这名字与福乐有关。

sampleVerse.text: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

explanation.en: Balak son of Zippor was king of Moab when Israel camped near his territory. Numbers 22:6 records him hiring Balaam to curse Israel because he feared their strength, although God's blessing could not be reversed by divination.
explanation.zh: 西拨的儿子巴勒在以色列驻扎于摩押附近时作摩押王。民数记22:6记载他因惧怕以色列的力量，雇巴兰前来咒诅；然而术法无法推翻上帝的赐福。

sampleVerse.text: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.

explanation.en: Midian names Abraham's son by Keturah and the desert people descended from him east and south of Canaan. Exodus 2:15 records Moses fleeing Pharaoh to Midian, where his years as a shepherd prepared him for later leadership.
explanation.zh: 米甸既是亚伯拉罕由基土拉所生的儿子，也指其后裔在迦南东南方形成的旷野民族。出埃及记2:15记载摩西逃避法老来到米甸；他在那里牧羊的岁月预备了日后的领导。

sampleVerse.text: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.

explanation.en: Ahaz was a king of Judah who practiced idolatry and sought political security in Assyria rather than trusting God. Isaiah 7:12 records his pious-sounding refusal of God's offered sign, masking the unbelief that shaped his policy.
explanation.zh: 亚哈斯是犹大王，行偶像崇拜，并倚靠亚述寻求政治安全，而不信靠上帝。以赛亚书7:12记载他以敬虔口吻拒绝上帝主动赐下的兆头，掩饰了左右其政策的不信。

sampleVerse.text: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the LORD.

explanation.en: Merari was Levi's youngest son and ancestor of one of the three main Levitical clans. Numbers 3:36 assigns his descendants responsibility for the tabernacle's boards, bars, pillars, sockets, and related structural parts.
explanation.zh: 米拉利是利未最小的儿子，也是利未三大宗族之一的先祖。民数记3:36把会幕的板、闩、柱、卯座和相关结构交给他的后裔负责。

sampleVerse.text: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,

explanation.en: Samson was a Nazirite judge given extraordinary strength to fight Philistine oppression, yet repeatedly weakened by uncontrolled desire. Judges 16:30 records his final act of pulling down Dagon's temple, dying with the rulers he struck.
explanation.zh: 参孙是拿细耳人士师，上帝赐他非凡力量来抵抗非利士压迫，他却屡次因放纵欲望而软弱。士师记16:30记载他最后推倒大衮神庙，与所击杀的非利士首领一同死去。

sampleVerse.text: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that were therein. So the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life.

explanation.en: Gilgal was Israel's first major camp west of the Jordan and a place of circumcision, Passover, and later national gatherings. Joshua 5:9 links its name with God rolling away the reproach of Egypt after the new generation renewed the covenant sign.
explanation.zh: 吉甲是以色列过约旦河后在西岸的第一个重要营地，也是行割礼、守逾越节和后来举行全国集会的地方。约书亚记5:9把这名字与上帝“滚去”埃及的羞辱相连，因为新一代在那里恢复盟约记号。

sampleVerse.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.

explanation.en: Heshbon was the Amorite king Sihon's capital east of the Jordan and later a city allotted to Reuben and the Levites. Numbers 21:26 identifies it as Sihon's city after he had taken the surrounding territory from Moab.
explanation.zh: 希实本是亚摩利王西宏在约旦河东的都城，后来分给流便支派和利未人。民数记21:26称它为西宏之城，并说明西宏此前从摩押夺取了周围土地。

sampleVerse.text: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.

explanation.en: Amaziah son of Joash was king of Judah, remembered for both obedience and damaging pride after military success. Second Chronicles 25:2 says he did what was right, but not with a perfect heart, summarizing the divided character of his reign.
explanation.zh: 约阿施的儿子亚玛谢作犹大王；他既有顺服的一面，也在军事成功后因骄傲而受损。历代志下25:2说他行耶和华眼中看为正的事，却不是专心而行，概括了他统治中的矛盾。

sampleVerse.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, but not with a perfect heart.

explanation.en: Gibeon was an important Hivite city whose leaders deceived Israel by pretending to come from a distant land. Joshua 9:15 records Joshua making peace with them without first seeking God's counsel, creating a treaty Israel was then bound to honor.
explanation.zh: 基遍是重要的希未人城市；它的首领假装来自远方，以此欺骗以色列。约书亚记9:15记载约书亚未先求问上帝便与他们立约，使以色列此后有责任遵守这约。

sampleVerse.text: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.

explanation.en: Joash was preserved from Athaliah's massacre, crowned as a child, and became king of Judah under the guidance of Jehoiada the priest. Second Kings 12:2 says he did right while Jehoiada instructed him, highlighting both the reform and its dependence on wise counsel.
explanation.zh: 约阿施在亚他利雅的屠杀中被保存，幼年加冕，并在祭司耶何耶大的指导下作犹大王。列王纪下12:2说耶何耶大教导他期间，他行耶和华眼中看为正的事，既显出改革，也显出良好劝导的重要。

sampleVerse.text: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

explanation.en: Nathan was a prophet who advised David, announced God's covenant promise, and courageously confronted the king's sin. In 2 Samuel 12:7 his words 'Thou art the man' expose David's guilt after the parable of the stolen ewe lamb.
explanation.zh: 拿单是先知，曾劝导大卫、宣告上帝的盟约应许，也勇敢责备王的罪。撒母耳记下12:7中，他讲完被夺小母羊的比喻后直指大卫：“你就是那人。”

sampleVerse.text: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man. Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;

explanation.en: Sihon was the Amorite king of Heshbon who controlled territory east of the Jordan. Numbers 21:23 records his refusal to let Israel pass and his attack at Jahaz, a decision that led to his defeat and the loss of his land.
explanation.zh: 西宏是希实本的亚摩利王，控制约旦河东的土地。民数记21:23记载他拒绝让以色列经过，并在雅杂出兵攻击；这个决定最终使他战败失地。

sampleVerse.text: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

explanation.en: Ishmael was Abraham's first son, born to Hagar, and became ancestor of a numerous people outside the covenant line through Isaac. Genesis 16:15 records his birth and Abraham's naming him as the angel had instructed Hagar.
explanation.zh: 以实玛利是亚伯拉罕由夏甲所生的长子，后来成为众多民族的先祖，但应许之约的谱系经由以撒延续。创世记16:15记载他的出生，也记下亚伯拉罕照天使给夏甲的指示为他命名。

sampleVerse.text: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.

explanation.en: Caleb represented Judah among the twelve spies and, with Joshua, trusted God when the others spread fear. Numbers 14:24 commends his different spirit and wholehearted following, promising that he would enter the land he explored.
explanation.zh: 迦勒代表犹大支派作十二探子之一；当其他人散布恐惧时，他与约书亚仍信靠上帝。民数记14:24称赞他有不同的心志、专一跟从，并应许他必进入所窥探之地。

sampleVerse.text: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

explanation.en: Leah was Laban's older daughter, Jacob's first wife, and mother of six tribal ancestors including Judah and Levi. Genesis 29:31 says the LORD saw that she was unloved and opened her womb, meeting her pain with compassionate attention.
explanation.zh: 利亚是拉班的大女儿、雅各的第一位妻子，也是犹大、利未等六位支派先祖的母亲。创世记29:31说耶和华看见她失宠，便使她生育，以怜悯眷顾她的痛苦。

sampleVerse.text: And when the LORD saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.

explanation.en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was one of David's mighty men, commander of his bodyguard, and a loyal supporter of Solomon. First Kings 2:35 records Solomon placing him over the army, completing his rise to Israel's chief military office.
explanation.zh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅是大卫的勇士和护卫长，也是所罗门忠诚的支持者。列王纪上2:35记载所罗门立他统领军队，使他升任以色列最高军职。

sampleVerse.text: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.

explanation.en: Gath was one of the five chief Philistine cities and the hometown of the giant Goliath. First Samuel 17:4 introduces Goliath of Gath challenging Israel, setting the scene for David's victory.
explanation.zh: 迦特是非利士五座主要城市之一，也是巨人歌利亚的家乡。撒母耳记上17:4介绍来自迦特的歌利亚向以色列挑战，由此展开大卫得胜的故事。

sampleVerse.text: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.

explanation.en: Ahaziah son of Ahab briefly ruled northern Israel and continued his parents' idolatrous pattern. Second Kings 1:2 records him seeking an oracle from Baal-zebub after a serious fall, provoking Elijah's message of judgment.
explanation.zh: 亚哈的儿子亚哈谢短暂统治北国以色列，并延续父母偶像崇拜的道路。列王纪下1:2记载他坠楼重伤后求问巴力西卜，因此招来以利亚的审判信息。

sampleVerse.text: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.

explanation.en: Seir is the rugged mountain region south of the Dead Sea that became the homeland of Esau's descendants, Edom. Genesis 36:8 states that Esau settled in Mount Seir, directly linking the place with the Edomite nation.
explanation.zh: 西珥是死海南方崎岖的山区，后来成为以扫后裔以东人的家园。创世记36:8说以扫住在西珥山，直接把这地方与以东民族相连。

sampleVerse.text: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

explanation.en: Shiloh was an Ephraimite town where Israel set up the tabernacle after entering Canaan. Joshua 18:1 records the congregation assembling there, making Shiloh the nation's early center of worship and land allocation.
explanation.zh: 示罗是以法莲境内的城，以色列进入迦南后在那里设立会幕。约书亚记18:1记载全会众聚集于此，使示罗成为早期全国敬拜和分地的中心。

sampleVerse.text: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.

explanation.en: Kohath was Levi's second son and ancestor of the Levitical clan that included Moses and Aaron. Numbers 3:31 assigns the Kohathites care of the ark and other sacred furnishings when the tabernacle traveled.
explanation.zh: 哥辖是利未的第二个儿子，也是包括摩西和亚伦在内之利未宗族的先祖。民数记3:31把约柜和其他圣所器具的搬运照管交给哥辖族。

sampleVerse.text: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.

explanation.en: Uzziah was a long-reigning king of Judah whose strength and achievements gave way to pride. Second Chronicles 26:16 records him unlawfully entering the temple to burn incense, an act followed by leprosy and isolation.
explanation.zh: 乌西雅是长期统治犹大的君王；他的力量和成就后来转变为骄傲。历代志下26:16记载他擅入圣殿烧香，随后患上大麻风并被隔离。

sampleVerse.text: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense upon the altar of incense.

explanation.en: Rebekah was Bethuel's daughter, Laban's sister, and the wife chosen for Isaac from Abraham's extended family. Genesis 24:67 records Isaac receiving her as his wife and finding comfort after his mother's death.
explanation.zh: 利百加是彼土利的女儿、拉班的妹妹，也是从亚伯拉罕亲族中为以撒选定的妻子。创世记24:67记载以撒娶她为妻，并在母亲去世后从她得到安慰。

sampleVerse.text: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.

explanation.en: Jezreel was a town and fertile valley where Israel's kings maintained a residence and where Naboth owned a vineyard. First Kings 21:1 introduces that vineyard beside Ahab's palace, setting up the royal abuse that Elijah condemned.
explanation.zh: 耶斯列是一座城及其肥沃谷地，以色列诸王在那里有行宫，拿伯也在那里拥有葡萄园。列王纪上21:1介绍亚哈王宫旁的葡萄园，由此展开以利亚所谴责的王权滥用。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

explanation.en: Adam is both the name of the first man and a Hebrew term related to humanity and the ground. Genesis 2:7 says God formed him from dust and breathed into him the breath of life, presenting the whole living person as the result of God's creative gift.
explanation.zh: 亚当既是第一个人的名字，也与希伯来语中的“人”和“土地”相关。创世记2:7说上帝用尘土造他，把生命之气吹入，显明完整而有生命的人来自上帝创造的恩赐。

sampleVerse.text: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

explanation.en: Hamath was a major city and kingdom on the Orontes north of Israel. Numbers 34:8 uses the entrance of Hamath in describing the promised land's northern boundary, showing its importance as a geographic marker.
explanation.zh: 哈马是以色列北方、奥龙特斯河畔的重要城市和王国。民数记34:8在说明应许之地北界时提到哈马口，显示它作为地理标志的重要性。

sampleVerse.text: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:

explanation.en: Baasha of Issachar seized Israel's throne by assassinating Nadab and founded the northern kingdom's second dynasty. First Kings 15:27 records his conspiracy and attack at Gibbethon, beginning a reign that repeated Jeroboam's sins.
explanation.zh: 以萨迦人巴沙刺杀拿答夺取以色列王位，建立北国第二个王朝。列王纪上15:27记载他在基比顿发动叛变和袭击，由此开始一个继续耶罗波安罪行的统治。

sampleVerse.text: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.

explanation.en: Hilkiah was the high priest during Josiah's reign who discovered the neglected book of the law in the temple. Second Kings 22:8 records him giving the book to Shaphan, an event that triggered repentance and national reform.
explanation.zh: 希勒家是约西亚时代的大祭司，他在圣殿中发现了被遗忘的律法书。列王纪下22:8记载他把书交给沙番；这件事引发了悔改和全国改革。

sampleVerse.text: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

explanation.en: Persia was the empire that conquered Babylon and permitted Jewish exiles to return and rebuild Jerusalem. Daniel 8:20 identifies the vision's two-horned ram with the kings of Media and Persia, placing the empire within prophetic history.
explanation.zh: 波斯是征服巴比伦、并准许犹太被掳者回去重建耶路撒冷的帝国。但以理书8:20把异象中双角的公绵羊解释为玛代和波斯诸王，使这个帝国进入预言历史的图景。

sampleVerse.text: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.

explanation.en: Mizpah means watchtower and was used for several elevated places in biblical geography. Genesis 31:49 gives the name to the memorial where Jacob and Laban parted under a covenant, calling on the LORD to watch between them.
explanation.zh: 米斯巴意为“守望台”，圣经中有几处高地都使用这个名称。创世记31:49把这名用于雅各与拉班立约分手的纪念地点，求耶和华在彼此分离时鉴察双方。

sampleVerse.text: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

explanation.en: Shaphan was King Josiah's secretary and belonged to a family that later protected faithful prophets. Second Kings 22:10 records him reading the rediscovered book of the law to the king, carrying its message from temple to throne.
explanation.zh: 沙番是约西亚王的书记，出自后来保护忠心先知的家族。列王纪下22:10记载他把重新发现的律法书读给王听，使圣殿中发现的信息传到王宫。

sampleVerse.text: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

explanation.en: Zeruiah was David's sister and the mother of his prominent warriors Abishai, Joab, and Asahel. First Chronicles 2:16 preserves this family link, explaining why her sons stood so near David's military and political life.
explanation.zh: 洗鲁雅是大卫的姐姐，也是勇士亚比筛、约押和亚撒黑的母亲。历代志上2:16保存了这层亲属关系，说明她的儿子为何在大卫的军事和政治生活中如此重要。

sampleVerse.text: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

explanation.en: Ezra was a priest and skilled scribe who led returning exiles from Babylon and taught God's law in Judah. Ezra 7:10 summarizes his ministry as preparing his heart to study, practice, and teach the law.
explanation.zh: 以斯拉是祭司和精通律法的文士，带领被掳者从巴比伦归回，并在犹大教导上帝的律法。以斯拉记7:10把他的事工概括为立志考究、遵行并教导律法。

sampleVerse.text: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

explanation.en: Uriah the Hittite was Bathsheba's husband and one of David's soldiers, wronged through the king's adultery and lethal scheme. Second Samuel 11:11 shows his integrity as he refuses comfort while the ark and fellow troops remain in the field.
explanation.zh: 赫人乌利亚是拔示巴的丈夫和大卫的士兵，却遭王以通奸和杀人阴谋严重亏负。撒母耳记下11:11显出他的忠诚：约柜和同袍仍在战场时，他拒绝回家享受安逸。

sampleVerse.text: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as thou livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.

explanation.en: Abishai was David's nephew, Joab's brother, and a courageous but often violent warrior. In 1 Samuel 26:8 he offers to kill the sleeping Saul, while David's refusal demonstrates restraint toward the LORD's anointed.
explanation.zh: 亚比筛是大卫的外甥、约押的兄弟，也是勇敢却常显暴烈的战士。撒母耳记上26:8中，他请求杀死熟睡的扫罗；大卫拒绝，显出对耶和华受膏者的克制。

sampleVerse.text: Then said Abishai to David, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.

explanation.en: Amnon was David's eldest son, whose lust led him to rape his half-sister Tamar and bring disaster into the royal family. Second Samuel 13:14 states that he overpowered her despite her resistance, naming his act as violence rather than romance.
explanation.zh: 暗嫩是大卫的长子；他的私欲使他强暴同父异母的妹妹她玛，并给王室带来灾难。撒母耳记下13:14说他不顾她的反抗，以强力制服她，明确显出这不是爱情，而是暴力。

sampleVerse.text: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.

explanation.en: Boaz was a wealthy and honorable Bethlehemite who acted as kinsman-redeemer for Ruth and Naomi's family. Ruth 4:13 records his marriage to Ruth and the birth God enabled, leading into the family line of David.
explanation.zh: 波阿斯是伯利恒富有而正直的人，为路得和拿俄米的家庭履行至亲救赎者的责任。路得记4:13记载他娶路得，并由上帝赐下后裔，使这个家庭进入大卫的谱系。

sampleVerse.text: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, the LORD gave her conception, and she bare a son.

explanation.en: Mount Carmel is the coastal ridge where Elijah confronted the prophets supported by Ahab and Jezebel. First Kings 18:20 records Israel and Baal's prophets gathering there for the contest that would reveal whom the people should worship.
explanation.zh: 迦密山是靠海的山脉，以利亚在那里对抗亚哈和耶洗别所支持的先知。列王纪上18:20记载以色列人和巴力先知聚集于此，要借一场较量显明百姓应当敬拜谁。

sampleVerse.text: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.

explanation.en: Baruch son of Neriah was Jeremiah's faithful scribe and companion during Judah's final years. Jeremiah 36:4 records him writing on a scroll the prophetic words Jeremiah dictated, preserving a message the king later tried to burn.
explanation.zh: 尼利亚的儿子巴录是耶利米忠心的书记和同伴，与他一同经历犹大末期。耶利米书36:4记载他把先知口述的话写在卷上，保存了后来被王试图焚毁的信息。

sampleVerse.text: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.

explanation.en: Amalek names Esau's descendant and the hostile people associated with him in the southern wilderness. Exodus 17:8 records the Amalekites attacking Israel at Rephidim, beginning a long history of conflict.
explanation.zh: 亚玛力既是以扫的后裔，也指与他相关、住在南方旷野的敌对民族。出埃及记17:8记载亚玛力人在利非订攻击以色列，由此开始长期冲突。

sampleVerse.text: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

explanation.en: Hiram was king of Tyre and a friendly ally of both David and Solomon who supplied materials and craftsmen. First Kings 5:1 records him sending servants to Solomon after hearing of his accession, opening cooperation for the temple project.
explanation.zh: 希兰是推罗王，也是大卫和所罗门的友好盟友，曾供应材料与工匠。列王纪上5:1记载他听见所罗门登基便差遣臣仆前来，由此展开圣殿工程的合作。

sampleVerse.text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

explanation.en: Lachish was a fortified city southwest of Jerusalem and a key defense point for Judah. Second Kings 18:14 places the Assyrian king there during his invasion, when Hezekiah attempted to buy relief from the siege.
explanation.zh: 拉吉是耶路撒冷西南的坚城，也是犹大的重要防线。列王纪下18:14记载亚述王入侵时驻在拉吉，希西家曾试图以贡物换取解围。

sampleVerse.text: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

explanation.en: Jonah son of Amittai was an Israelite prophet sent to warn the Assyrian city of Nineveh. Jonah 3:3 records his eventual obedience after fleeing and being rescued, as he finally enters the great city with God's message.
explanation.zh: 亚米太的儿子约拿是以色列先知，蒙差遣去警告亚述大城尼尼微。约拿书3:3记载他逃跑并获救后终于顺服，进入大城传达上帝的信息。

sampleVerse.text: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the LORD. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' journey.

explanation.en: Judea was the Roman-era southern region of the biblical land, centered on Jerusalem and Bethlehem. Matthew 2:1 locates Jesus' birth in Bethlehem of Judea during Herod's reign, anchoring the nativity in that political setting.
explanation.zh: 犹太是罗马时代圣经地区的南部区域，以耶路撒冷和伯利恒为中心。马太福音2:1把耶稣的降生定位在希律统治时的犹太伯利恒，使圣诞故事具有明确的政治地理背景。

sampleVerse.text: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

explanation.en: Hazael was a Syrian officer who murdered Ben-hadad and became king, later oppressing Israel as Elisha had foreseen. Second Kings 8:15 records him suffocating the sick king and taking the throne, exposing the violence behind his rise.
explanation.zh: 哈薛原是叙利亚官员，他杀死便哈达夺取王位，后来按以利沙预见的那样压迫以色列。列王纪下8:15记载他使病中的王窒息而死并篡位，显出其崛起背后的暴力。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.

explanation.en: Jotham son of Uzziah was king of Judah and strengthened the kingdom while avoiding his father's temple presumption. Second Chronicles 27:2 says he did right before the LORD, though the people still acted corruptly.
explanation.zh: 乌西雅的儿子约坦作犹大王，坚固国家，也避免重犯父亲擅入圣殿的罪。历代志下27:2说他行耶和华眼中看为正的事，但百姓仍然败坏。

sampleVerse.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the LORD. And the people did yet corruptly.

explanation.en: Sidon was an ancient Phoenician coastal city north of Tyre and a center of maritime trade. First Kings 17:9 sends Elijah into Sidonian territory to a widow at Zarephath, where God sustains both prophet and foreign household during famine.
explanation.zh: 西顿是推罗北方古老的腓尼基海港，也是海上贸易中心。列王纪上17:9差以利亚进入西顿境内的撒勒法，到一位寡妇那里；饥荒中，上帝在那里供应先知和外族家庭。

sampleVerse.text: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.
