explanation.en: Haran was the Mesopotamian city where Terah's family settled after leaving Ur and where Abraham later received God's call to continue. Genesis 11:31 records the migration stopping there on its way toward Canaan.
explanation.zh: 哈兰是美索不达米亚的城市；他拉一家离开吾珥后定居于此，亚伯拉罕后来也在这里领受继续前行的呼召。创世记11:31记载他们往迦南的迁移在此暂时停下。

sampleVerse.text: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

explanation.en: Ornan, called Araunah elsewhere, was a Jebusite owner of a threshing floor in Jerusalem. First Chronicles 21:22 records David asking to buy that site for an altar to stop the plague; it later became the temple location.
explanation.zh: 阿珥楠在别处称亚劳拿，是在耶路撒冷拥有禾场的耶布斯人。历代志上21:22记载大卫求购那地筑坛止住瘟疫；那里后来成为圣殿所在地。

sampleVerse.text: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.

explanation.en: Ziba was a former servant of Saul whom David assigned to manage land for Jonathan's disabled son Mephibosheth. Second Samuel 9:2 introduces him as the source who tells David that a member of Saul's house still lives.
explanation.zh: 洗巴原是扫罗的仆人，后来大卫派他为约拿单瘸腿的儿子米非波设管理土地。撒母耳记下9:2介绍他向大卫提供消息，说明扫罗家仍有后人活着。

sampleVerse.text: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he.

explanation.en: Ahimaaz son of Zadok served David as a swift messenger during Absalom's revolt. Second Samuel 18:27 records David recognizing his running style and expecting good news, though Ahimaaz avoided announcing Absalom's death.
explanation.zh: 撒督的儿子亚希玛斯在押沙龙叛乱时作大卫的快足信使。撒母耳记下18:27记载大卫认出他的跑法并期待好消息，尽管亚希玛斯避而不报押沙龙的死讯。

sampleVerse.text: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.

explanation.en: Heman was a Levitical singer and seer appointed to lead music in David's sanctuary worship. First Chronicles 15:19 names him among the singers sounding brass cymbals when the ark was brought to Jerusalem.
explanation.zh: 希幔是利未歌唱者和先见，被任命在大卫时代领导圣所音乐。历代志上15:19把他列在约柜迎入耶路撒冷时敲响铜钹的歌唱者中。

sampleVerse.text: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;

explanation.en: Naaman was Syria's respected army commander whose leprosy brought him to the prophet Elisha. Second Kings 5:14 records his reluctant obedience in dipping seven times in the Jordan and his complete healing.
explanation.zh: 乃缦是受尊重的叙利亚元帅，因大麻风来到先知以利沙面前。列王纪下5:14记载他最终顺服，在约旦河沐浴七次，身体完全复原。

sampleVerse.text: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

explanation.en: Obadiah was the manager of Ahab's household who quietly remained faithful during Jezebel's persecution. First Kings 18:4 records him hiding and feeding one hundred prophets of the LORD at great personal risk.
explanation.zh: 俄巴底是在亚哈宫中任职的管家，在耶洗别迫害期间仍暗中忠于上帝。列王纪上18:4记载他冒着个人危险，把耶和华的一百位先知分藏在洞里并供应食物。

sampleVerse.text: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

explanation.en: Ruth was a Moabite widow whose loyal commitment to Naomi brought her to Bethlehem and into David's family line. Ruth 1:16 voices her choice of Naomi's people and God, a covenant loyalty that directs the rest of her story.
explanation.zh: 路得是摩押寡妇；她忠于拿俄米，来到伯利恒，并进入大卫的家谱。路得记1:16表达她选择拿俄米的民族和上帝；这份盟约般的忠诚引导了后续故事。

sampleVerse.text: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

explanation.en: Succoth was Israel's first recorded stopping place after leaving Rameses in the Exodus and also the name of a town east of Jordan. Exodus 12:37 counts the departing company as it journeys there, marking freedom's first stage.
explanation.zh: 疏割是以色列出埃及时离开兰塞后的第一个记载停留地，也是约旦河东一座城的名字。出埃及记12:37数点前往那里的队伍，标志自由旅程的第一站。

sampleVerse.text: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.

explanation.en: Amasa was David's nephew whom Absalom appointed commander during his rebellion and whom David later offered Joab's post. Second Samuel 17:25 identifies his parents and military command, setting up the rivalry in which Joab killed him.
explanation.zh: 亚玛撒是大卫的外甥，押沙龙叛乱时任命他为元帅，大卫后来又答应让他取代约押。撒母耳记下17:25说明他的父母和军职，为约押后来因竞争杀他铺路。

sampleVerse.text: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man's son, whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab's mother.

explanation.en: Barak son of Abinoam was the commander called through Deborah to fight Sisera's Canaanite army. Judges 4:8 records his insistence that Deborah accompany him, revealing both dependence on prophetic assurance and hesitation.
explanation.zh: 亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉是借底波拉蒙召、去对抗西西拉迦南军队的将领。士师记4:8记载他坚持底波拉必须同行，既显出对先知保证的倚赖，也显出犹疑。

sampleVerse.text: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, then I will not go.

explanation.en: Eliab was Jesse's eldest son and David's older brother, whose impressive appearance caught Samuel's attention. First Samuel 16:6 records Samuel assuming he was God's chosen king before learning that God looks on the heart.
explanation.zh: 以利押是耶西的长子、大卫的哥哥，他出众的外表首先吸引撒母耳。撒母耳记上16:6记载撒母耳以为他就是蒙拣选的王，随后才学到上帝察看的是内心。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass, when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the LORD'S anointed is before him.

explanation.en: Gezer was a strategic Canaanite city overlooking routes between the coast and hill country. First Kings 9:16 says Pharaoh captured and burned it, then gave it to his daughter as a wedding gift when she married Solomon.
explanation.zh: 基色是控制沿海与山地通道的战略性迦南城市。列王纪上9:16说法老攻取并焚烧此城，在女儿嫁给所罗门时把它作为嫁妆。

sampleVerse.text: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon's wife.

explanation.en: Hushai the Archite was David's loyal friend who returned to Jerusalem as a covert adviser during Absalom's rebellion. Second Samuel 15:34 records David commissioning him to frustrate Ahithophel's counsel from inside the rebel court.
explanation.zh: 亚基人户筛是大卫忠诚的朋友；押沙龙叛乱时，他回耶路撒冷作秘密顾问。撒母耳记下15:34记载大卫差他从叛军宫廷内部破坏亚希多弗的计谋。

sampleVerse.text: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father's servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.

explanation.en: Joppa was an ancient Mediterranean port serving Jerusalem and later known as Jaffa. Acts 9:36 introduces the generous disciple Tabitha there, whose death and restoration through Peter moved many in the city to believe.
explanation.zh: 约帕是服务耶路撒冷的古老地中海港口，后来称雅法。使徒行传9:36介绍当地乐善好施的门徒大比大；她死后借彼得复生，使城中许多人相信。

sampleVerse.text: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

explanation.en: Miriam was the sister of Moses and Aaron, a prophetess who watched over Moses as an infant and helped lead Israel. Exodus 15:20 records her leading the women with timbrels and song after deliverance through the Red Sea.
explanation.zh: 米利暗是摩西和亚伦的姐姐，也是女先知；她曾看护婴儿摩西，后来协助领导以色列。出埃及记15:20记载过红海得救后，她带领妇女击鼓歌唱。

sampleVerse.text: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

explanation.en: Pharez, also called Perez, was the son of Judah and Tamar and ancestor of Boaz and David. Genesis 38:29 connects his name with the unexpected breach by which he emerged before his twin brother.
explanation.zh: 法勒斯又称法勒斯，是犹大和她玛的儿子，也是波阿斯与大卫的先祖。创世记38:29把他的名字与他出人意料地抢在双胞胎兄弟之前出生的“突破”相连。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

explanation.en: Rabbah was the fortified capital of the Ammonites, located at modern Amman. Second Samuel 12:26 records Joab taking its royal sector during David's Ammonite war, shortly after the events involving Uriah.
explanation.zh: 拉巴是亚扪人的坚固首都，位于今日安曼。撒母耳记下12:26记载约押在大卫攻打亚扪的战争中夺取王城，时间紧接乌利亚事件之后。

sampleVerse.text: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

explanation.en: Titus was a Gentile believer, trusted coworker of Paul, and later organizer of churches in Crete. Galatians 2:3 says church leaders did not compel him to be circumcised, affirming that Gentile salvation did not depend on becoming Jewish.
explanation.zh: 提多是外邦信徒、保罗信任的同工，后来在克里特整顿众教会。加拉太书2:3说教会领袖没有强迫他受割礼，确认外邦人得救不以先成为犹太人为条件。

sampleVerse.text: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

explanation.en: Tobiah the Ammonite was an influential official who opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding of Jerusalem. Nehemiah 2:10 introduces his displeasure that anyone had come to seek Israel's welfare, foreshadowing ridicule, threats, and intrigue.
explanation.zh: 亚扪人多比雅是有影响力的官员，反对尼希米重建耶路撒冷。尼希米记2:10说他因有人来为以色列人求好处而恼怒，预示后来的讥笑、威胁和阴谋。

sampleVerse.text: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

explanation.en: Uzziel was Kohath's youngest son, Levi's grandson, and ancestor of a Levitical clan. Exodus 6:18 lists him beside Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, locating his family within the tribe responsible for sacred service.
explanation.zh: 乌薛是哥辖最小的儿子、利未的孙子，也是一个利未宗族的先祖。出埃及记6:18把他与暗兰、以斯哈和希伯仑并列，使其家族归入负责圣职的支派。

sampleVerse.text: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.

explanation.en: Ziklag was a southern town that the Philistine king Achish assigned to David during his exile from Saul. First Samuel 27:6 records the gift and explains why the town later belonged to Judah's kings.
explanation.zh: 洗革拉是南方城镇，大卫逃避扫罗期间，非利士王亚吉把它分给大卫。撒母耳记上27:6记载这次赐予，也解释该城为何后来归犹大诸王。

sampleVerse.text: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.

explanation.en: Amoz was the father of the prophet Isaiah and should not be confused with the prophet Amos. Isaiah 1:1 identifies Isaiah by this parentage while dating his visions across four kings of Judah.
explanation.zh: 亚摩斯是先知以赛亚的父亲，不应与先知阿摩司混淆。以赛亚书1:1以这层父子关系介绍以赛亚，并把他的异象定在犹大四位君王时期。

sampleVerse.text: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

explanation.en: Amram was a Kohathite Levite who married Jochebed and became the father of Aaron and Moses, with Miriam also belonging to the family. Exodus 6:20 records this household within the genealogy of Israel's deliverers and priests.
explanation.zh: 暗兰是哥辖族利未人，娶约基别为妻，生亚伦和摩西，米利暗也属于这个家庭。出埃及记6:20把这家列入以色列拯救者和祭司的谱系。

sampleVerse.text: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.

explanation.en: Geba was a Benjaminite Levitical town near the northern border of Judah. First Kings 15:22 records Asa using stones and timber from Baasha's abandoned fortification at Ramah to build up Geba and Mizpah.
explanation.zh: 迦巴是便雅悯境内的利未城，靠近犹大北界。列王纪上15:22记载亚撒用巴沙遗留在拉玛的石木，加固迦巴和米斯巴。

sampleVerse.text: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

explanation.en: Goshen was the fertile Egyptian district where Joseph settled Jacob's family and where Israel grew before enslavement. Genesis 47:27 records them gaining possessions and multiplying there during the famine years.
explanation.zh: 歌珊是埃及的肥沃地区，约瑟把雅各一家安置在那里；以色列在受奴役前也在那里增长。创世记47:27记载他们在荒年中置产、生育并人数增多。

sampleVerse.text: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

explanation.en: Hamor was a Hivite leader near Shechem and father of the man also named Shechem. Genesis 33:19 records Jacob buying a field from Hamor's sons, land later connected with Joseph's burial.
explanation.zh: 哈抹是示剑附近的希未人首领，也是同名之子示剑的父亲。创世记33:19记载雅各从哈抹的子孙买下一块地，后来这地与约瑟的安葬有关。

sampleVerse.text: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.

explanation.en: Heth was a son of Canaan and ancestor-name of the Hittites encountered around Hebron. Genesis 23:3 introduces the sons of Heth as the community from whom Abraham sought a burial place for Sarah.
explanation.zh: 赫是迦南的儿子，也是希伯仑一带赫人的祖先之名。创世记23:3介绍赫人为亚伯拉罕求购撒拉坟地时所面对的当地群体。

sampleVerse.text: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,

explanation.en: Jethro was Moses' Midianite father-in-law and priest who welcomed him during exile and later visited Israel. Exodus 18:17 begins his wise warning that Moses' solitary way of judging the people was unsustainable.
explanation.zh: 叶忒罗是摩西的米甸岳父和祭司，在摩西流亡时接纳他，后来又探访以色列。出埃及记18:17开始记下他的明智警告：摩西独自审理百姓的方式无法长久维持。

sampleVerse.text: And Moses' father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.

explanation.en: Lazarus of Bethany was the brother of Martha and Mary and a friend whom Jesus loved. John 11:43 records Jesus calling him out of the tomb after four days, a public sign of Christ's resurrection power.
explanation.zh: 伯大尼的拉撒路是马大和马利亚的兄弟，也是耶稣所爱的人。约翰福音11:43记载他死后四天，耶稣呼唤他走出坟墓，公开显明基督使人复活的权柄。

sampleVerse.text: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

explanation.en: Maachah daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur, was one of David's wives and the mother of Absalom. Second Samuel 3:3 identifies her in David's Hebron household, explaining Absalom's connection to both Israel and Geshur.
explanation.zh: 基述王达买的女儿玛迦是大卫的妻子之一，也是押沙龙的母亲。撒母耳记下3:3在大卫的希伯仑家庭中介绍她，说明押沙龙与以色列、基述两地的关系。

sampleVerse.text: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

explanation.en: Abel was Adam and Eve's second son, a shepherd murdered by his jealous brother Cain. Hebrews 11:4 says he offered a better sacrifice by faith and, though dead, still speaks through that witness.
explanation.zh: 亚伯是亚当和夏娃的第二个儿子，是被嫉妒他的哥哥该隐杀害的牧人。希伯来书11:4说他因信献上更美的祭；虽然死了，仍借这见证说话。

sampleVerse.text: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.

explanation.en: Andrew was a fisherman from Bethsaida, Peter's brother, and one of Jesus' first disciples. John 1:41 records him finding Peter and announcing that they had found the Messiah, beginning his pattern of bringing people to Jesus.
explanation.zh: 安得烈是伯赛大的渔夫、彼得的兄弟，也是耶稣最早的门徒之一。约翰福音1:41记载他先找到彼得，宣告他们遇见了弥赛亚，由此开始他领人到耶稣面前的行动。

sampleVerse.text: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.

explanation.en: Aroer was a town overlooking the Arnon gorge at the southern edge of Sihon's former territory. Deuteronomy 2:36 names it first in its survey of the cities Israel captured east of Jordan.
explanation.zh: 亚罗珥是俯瞰亚嫩河峡谷的城，位于西宏旧领地南端。申命记2:36以它为起点，说明以色列在约旦河东所攻取的诸城。

sampleVerse.text: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:

explanation.en: Martha of Bethany was the sister of Mary and Lazarus, remembered for practical hospitality and candid faith. John 11:27 records her confessing Jesus as the Christ and Son of God even while grieving her brother's death.
explanation.zh: 伯大尼的马大是马利亚和拉撒路的姐姐，以实际接待和坦率信心为人所知。约翰福音11:27记载她即使正在哀悼兄弟，仍承认耶稣是基督、是上帝的儿子。

sampleVerse.text: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

explanation.en: Seraiah was the chief priest in Jerusalem when Babylon destroyed the city and temple. Second Kings 25:18 records the captain of the guard taking him captive, after which he was executed at Riblah.
explanation.zh: 西莱雅是巴比伦毁灭耶路撒冷和圣殿时的大祭司。列王纪下25:18记载护卫长把他掳去，随后他在利比拉被处死。

sampleVerse.text: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

explanation.en: Abihu was Aaron's second son and one of the first priests of Israel. Leviticus 10:1 records him and Nadab offering strange fire that God had not commanded, a fatal violation of sanctuary holiness.
explanation.zh: 亚比户是亚伦的第二个儿子，也是以色列最早的祭司之一。利未记10:1记载他与拿答献上上帝没有吩咐的凡火，严重违犯圣所的神圣。

sampleVerse.text: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.

explanation.en: Agrippa II was a Herodian ruler who heard Paul's defense before Festus and Bernice. Acts 26:28 records his famous response about almost being persuaded to become a Christian after Paul directly appealed to his belief in the prophets.
explanation.zh: 亚基帕二世是希律家族的统治者，与非斯都和百尼基一同听保罗申辩。使徒行传26:28记载保罗直接诉诸他对先知的信仰后，他作出“几乎被劝成为基督徒”的著名回应。

sampleVerse.text: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.

explanation.en: Eliakim son of Hilkiah was a faithful palace official chosen to replace the proud steward Shebna. Isaiah 22:20 records God calling him to office, after which he receives authority pictured by the key of David's house.
explanation.zh: 希勒家的儿子以利亚敬是忠心的宫廷官员，蒙召取代骄傲的管家舍伯那。以赛亚书22:20记载上帝召他任职，随后以大卫家钥匙的图像把权柄交给他。

sampleVerse.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:

explanation.en: Gehazi was Elisha's servant whose greed led him to obtain secret payment from the healed Naaman. Second Kings 5:25 records him lying to Elisha after returning, just before his deceit is exposed and punished.
explanation.zh: 基哈西是以利沙的仆人，因贪心暗中向得医治的乃缦索取财物。列王纪下5:25记载他回来后向以利沙撒谎，随即欺骗被揭露并受惩罚。

sampleVerse.text: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence comest thou, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.

explanation.en: Hagar was Sarah's Egyptian servant, the mother of Ishmael, and a vulnerable woman twice met by God in the wilderness. Genesis 16:13 records her naming the LORD as the God who sees her after receiving protection and promise.
explanation.zh: 夏甲是撒拉的埃及婢女和以实玛利的母亲，是一位两次在旷野蒙上帝寻找的弱势女子。创世记16:13记载她在得到保护与应许后，称耶和华为看顾她的上帝。

sampleVerse.text: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?

explanation.en: Haggai was a post-exile prophet who urged returned Jews to rebuild the neglected temple. Haggai 1:8 commands them to bring wood and build so that God may take pleasure in the restored house and be glorified.
explanation.zh: 哈该是被掳归回时期的先知，催促返乡的犹太人重建被忽略的圣殿。哈该书1:8吩咐他们上山取木建造，使上帝喜悦这恢复的殿并得荣耀。

sampleVerse.text: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the LORD.

explanation.en: Hannah was Samuel's mother, whose grief over childlessness became persistent prayer and a vow of dedication. First Samuel 1:27 identifies Samuel as the child for whom she prayed, acknowledging God's direct answer before she returned him to sanctuary service.
explanation.zh: 哈拿是撒母耳的母亲；她因无子而悲痛，却把痛苦转化为恒切祷告和献子誓愿。撒母耳记上1:27确认撒母耳就是她所求的孩子；她承认上帝亲自回应，随后把他带到圣所事奉。

sampleVerse.text: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:

explanation.en: Thomas, whose name means twin, was an apostle remembered for demanding evidence of Jesus' resurrection. John 20:28 records his answer when he meets the risen Christ: a direct confession of Jesus as his Lord and God.
explanation.zh: 多马的名字意为“双生”，是因要求耶稣复活证据而闻名的使徒。约翰福音20:28记载他遇见复活的基督后，直接承认耶稣是他的主、他的上帝。

sampleVerse.text: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

explanation.en: Cush was a son of Ham and the ancestral name connected with regions and peoples south of Egypt, especially ancient Nubia. Genesis 10:6 places him with Mizraim, Put, and Canaan in the post-flood table of nations.
explanation.zh: 古实是含的儿子，也是与埃及以南、特别是古努比亚地区和民族相连的祖先之名。创世记10:6在洪水后的列国谱系中，把他与麦西、弗和迦南并列。

sampleVerse.text: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.

explanation.en: Debir was a fortified hill-country city of Judah formerly called Kirjath-sepher. Joshua 15:17 records Othniel capturing it and receiving Caleb's daughter Achsah in marriage as promised.
explanation.zh: 底璧是犹大山地的坚城，原名基列西弗。约书亚记15:17记载俄陀聂攻取此城，并按迦勒的承诺娶其女押撒为妻。

sampleVerse.text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

explanation.en: Eliphaz the Temanite was the first of Job's three friends to speak, offering traditional wisdom that often misapplied truth to suffering. Job 4:1 opens his response after seven silent days, beginning the debate that God later corrects.
explanation.zh: 提幔人以利法是约伯三位朋友中第一个发言的；他提出传统智慧，却常把真理错误应用于苦难。约伯记4:1开始他在七日沉默后的回应，由此展开后来被上帝纠正的辩论。

sampleVerse.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

explanation.en: Ephron the Hittite owned the field and cave of Machpelah that Abraham sought for Sarah's burial. Genesis 23:16 records Abraham weighing his stated price of four hundred shekels, completing a public and permanent purchase.
explanation.zh: 赫人以弗仑拥有麦比拉的田和洞，就是亚伯拉罕为安葬撒拉所求购之地。创世记23:16记载亚伯拉罕称出他所开的四百舍客勒银子，公开而永久地完成交易。

sampleVerse.text: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.

explanation.en: Jazer was an Amorite town east of Jordan that became part of Gad's territory and later a Levitical city. Numbers 32:35 lists it among the settlements the Gadites rebuilt for their families and livestock.
explanation.zh: 雅谢是约旦河东的亚摩利城，后来归迦得支派，并成为利未人的城。民数记32:35把它列在迦得人为家人和牲畜重建的聚落中。

sampleVerse.text: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

explanation.en: Megiddo was a strategic fortified city overlooking the Jezreel Valley and a route used by armies and trade. Second Kings 23:29 records King Josiah's fatal encounter with Pharaoh-necho there, making the site a symbol of decisive battle.
explanation.zh: 米吉多是俯瞰耶斯列谷的战略坚城，控制军队和商旅通道。列王纪下23:29记载约西亚王在那里与法老尼哥相遇并受致命伤，使此地成为决定性战争的象征。

sampleVerse.text: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

explanation.en: Ophir was a distant region famed for exceptionally fine gold, though its precise location remains uncertain. First Kings 9:28 records Hiram and Solomon's fleet bringing a great weight of gold from there to Jerusalem.
explanation.zh: 俄斐是以优质黄金闻名的远方地区，确切位置至今不能确定。列王纪上9:28记载希兰和所罗门的船队从那里运回大量黄金到耶路撒冷。

sampleVerse.text: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.

explanation.en: Zebedee was a Galilean fisherman, husband of Salome, and father of the apostles James and John. Matthew 4:21 pictures him in the boat mending nets with his sons when Jesus calls them away to discipleship.
explanation.zh: 西庇太是加利利渔夫、撒罗米的丈夫，也是使徒雅各和约翰的父亲。马太福音4:21描写他与两个儿子在船上补网，此时耶稣呼召儿子离开跟从。

sampleVerse.text: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.

explanation.en: Zimri was an Israelite officer who murdered King Elah, seized the throne, and reigned only seven days. First Kings 16:18 records him burning the palace over himself when Omri captured Tirzah, ending his brief coup.
explanation.zh: 心利是以色列军官，杀害以拉王后篡位，却只统治七天。列王纪上16:18记载暗利攻入得撒时，他纵火焚烧王宫并死在其中，结束短暂政变。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king's house, and burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died,

explanation.en: Bethany was a village near Jerusalem on the eastern slope of the Mount of Olives and home of Mary, Martha, and Lazarus. John 11:1 introduces Lazarus' illness there, leading to the sign in which Jesus raises him from death.
explanation.zh: 伯大尼是耶路撒冷附近、橄榄山东坡的村庄，也是马利亚、马大和拉撒路的家。约翰福音11:1介绍拉撒路在那里患病，由此引出耶稣使他从死里复活的神迹。

sampleVerse.text: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

explanation.en: Japheth was one of Noah's three sons and ancestor of several peoples listed after the flood. Genesis 9:27 blesses him with enlargement and fellowship in Shem's tents, looking toward the widening of his descendants.
explanation.zh: 雅弗是挪亚三个儿子之一，也是洪水后谱系中多个民族的先祖。创世记9:27祝福他扩张，并住在闪的帐棚里，展望其后裔的广展。

sampleVerse.text: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

explanation.en: Kedar was Ishmael's son and the ancestor-name of Arabian pastoral tribes known for tents and flocks. Isaiah 60:7 envisions Kedar's flocks gathered in acceptable worship, drawing distant peoples into Zion's future restoration.
explanation.zh: 基达是以实玛利的儿子，也是以帐棚和羊群闻名之阿拉伯牧民部族的祖先之名。以赛亚书60:7展望基达的羊群被聚集、蒙悦纳地献上，使远方民族进入锡安将来的复兴。

sampleVerse.text: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.

explanation.en: Pekah son of Remaliah was an Israelite captain who assassinated Pekahiah and seized the northern throne. Second Kings 15:25 records the conspiracy and Gileadite support behind his rise, which later drew Israel into war with Judah.
explanation.zh: 利玛利的儿子比加是以色列将领，刺杀比加辖后夺取北国王位。列王纪下15:25记载这场阴谋和基列人的支持；他后来又把以色列带入与犹大的战争。

sampleVerse.text: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king's house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.

explanation.en: Riblah was a strategic town on the Orontes where Babylon's king kept headquarters during the final conquest of Judah. Second Kings 25:6 records the captured Zedekiah brought there for judgment before Jerusalem's destruction was completed.
explanation.zh: 利比拉是奥龙特斯河畔的战略城镇，巴比伦王在最后征服犹大时把总部设在那里。列王纪下25:6记载被擒的西底家被带到那里受审，随后耶路撒冷的毁灭完成。

sampleVerse.text: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.

explanation.en: Zobah was an Aramean kingdom north of Damascus extending toward the Euphrates. Second Samuel 8:3 records David defeating its king Hadadezer as he sought to restore control near the great river.
explanation.zh: 琐巴是大马士革以北、向幼发拉底河延伸的亚兰王国。撒母耳记下8:3记载其王哈大底谢试图恢复大河附近的权势时，被大卫击败。

sampleVerse.text: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.

explanation.en: Achaia was the Roman province covering southern Greece, with Corinth as its capital. Second Corinthians 1:1 addresses believers throughout Achaia along with the Corinthian church, showing a regional network larger than one city congregation.
explanation.zh: 亚该亚是覆盖希腊南部的罗马行省，以哥林多为首府。哥林多后书1:1除哥林多教会外，也向亚该亚各地圣徒致意，显示超越单一城市堂会的区域网络。

sampleVerse.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

explanation.en: Bilhah was Rachel's servant, given to Jacob within the ancient household system, and mother of Dan and Naphtali. Genesis 30:4 records this arrangement amid rivalry over children, revealing the pain and unequal power within the patriarchal family.
explanation.zh: 辟拉是拉结的婢女，在古代家庭制度中被给雅各为妻，生了但和拿弗他利。创世记30:4记载这项安排发生在争夺生育的竞争中，显出先祖家庭里的痛苦和权力不平等。

sampleVerse.text: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

explanation.en: Eglon was the Moabite king who allied with Ammon and Amalek and oppressed Israel for eighteen years. Judges 3:12 introduces his rise as judgment after Israel again did evil, before God raised Ehud as deliverer.
explanation.zh: 伊矶伦是摩押王，与亚扪和亚玛力结盟，压迫以色列十八年。士师记3:12在以色列再次行恶后介绍他的兴起，随后上帝兴起以笏施行拯救。

sampleVerse.text: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.

explanation.en: Jonadab son of Rechab founded the Rechabite way of life marked by tents and abstinence from wine. Jeremiah 35:6 records his descendants refusing wine centuries later out of loyalty to his command, contrasting their obedience with Judah's disobedience to God.
explanation.zh: 利甲的儿子约拿达设立利甲族住帐棚、戒酒的生活方式。耶利米书35:6记载数百年后他的后裔仍因忠于命令而拒绝饮酒，与犹大不顺从上帝形成对比。

sampleVerse.text: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine, neither ye, nor your sons for ever:

explanation.en: Michael means 'Who is like God?' and is portrayed as heaven's archangelic commander associated with the defense of God's people. Revelation 12:7 depicts Michael and his angels defeating the dragon's forces, keeping the focus on God's victory over evil.
explanation.zh: 米迦勒意为“谁能像上帝”，圣经把他描写为天上的天使长与统帅，与保护上帝百姓有关。启示录12:7描写米迦勒和他的使者击败龙的势力，把焦点放在上帝战胜罪恶之上。

sampleVerse.text: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

explanation.en: Terah was the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran and the family patriarch who began migration from Ur. Genesis 11:31 records him taking Abram, Sarai, and Lot toward Canaan but settling at Haran, where he later died.
explanation.zh: 他拉是亚伯兰、拿鹤和哈兰的父亲，也是带领家族离开吾珥的族长。创世记11:31记载他带亚伯兰、撒莱和罗得往迦南去，却停居哈兰并最终死在那里。

sampleVerse.text: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

explanation.en: Zebah was one of the two Midianite kings whose armies oppressed Israel and killed Gideon's brothers. Judges 8:12 records Gideon capturing Zebah and Zalmunna after pursuing their remaining force across the Jordan.
explanation.zh: 西巴是米甸两位王之一，他们的军队压迫以色列并杀害基甸的兄弟。士师记8:12记载基甸渡过约旦河追赶余军，最终擒获西巴和撒慕拿。

sampleVerse.text: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.

explanation.en: Ahitub in this priestly genealogy was the son of Amariah and father of Zadok, the priest prominent under David and Solomon. First Chronicles 6:8 preserves that descent within Aaron's line.
explanation.zh: 这段祭司家谱中的亚希突是亚玛利雅的儿子、撒督的父亲；撒督后来在大卫和所罗门时期担任重要祭司。历代志上6:8把这层传承保存在亚伦谱系中。

sampleVerse.text: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

explanation.en: Apollos was an eloquent Alexandrian Jew, powerful in Scripture and zealous in teaching what he knew of Jesus. Acts 18:26 records Priscilla and Aquila privately explaining God's way more accurately to him, after which his ministry greatly helped believers.
explanation.zh: 亚波罗是来自亚历山大的犹太人，善于讲论、熟悉圣经，并热心教导自己所知的耶稣。使徒行传18:26记载百基拉和亚居拉私下更准确地向他讲解上帝的道，之后他的事工大大帮助信徒。

sampleVerse.text: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.

explanation.en: Bela was Benjamin's first-named son and ancestor of a prominent Benjaminite clan; the name also belonged to other people and a city. First Chronicles 7:6 lists him with Becher and Jediael in Benjamin's genealogy.
explanation.zh: 比拉是便雅悯首先列出的儿子，也是便雅悯重要宗族的先祖；这个名字也用于其他人物和一座城。历代志上7:6在便雅悯家谱中把他与比结、耶叠并列。

sampleVerse.text: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

explanation.en: Cyprus is a large eastern Mediterranean island and the homeland of Barnabas. Acts 13:4 records Barnabas and Saul sailing there on the first missionary journey after the Holy Spirit sent them from Antioch.
explanation.zh: 塞浦路斯是地中海东部的大岛，也是巴拿巴的家乡。使徒行传13:4记载圣灵从安提阿差遣巴拿巴和扫罗后，他们乘船到这里开始第一次宣教旅程。

sampleVerse.text: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

explanation.en: Dagon was a chief Philistine deity worshiped in temples at Ashdod and Gaza. First Samuel 5:4 records his idol fallen and broken before the captured ark, showing that the Philistines had not conquered Israel's God.
explanation.zh: 大衮是非利士人的主要神明，在亚实突和迦萨设有庙宇。撒母耳记上5:4记载其偶像在被掳的约柜前倒下破碎，显明非利士人并没有胜过以色列的上帝。

sampleVerse.text: And when they arose early on the morrow morning, behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face to the ground before the ark of the LORD; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off upon the threshold; only the stump of Dagon was left to him.

explanation.en: Heber the Kenite separated from his clan and camped near Kedesh; his wife was Jael. Judges 4:11 explains his location before Sisera later seeks refuge in Jael's tent and meets his death there.
explanation.zh: 基尼人希百离开本族，在基低斯附近支搭帐棚；他的妻子是雅亿。士师记4:11先说明他所在之处，为西西拉后来逃入雅亿帐棚并死在那里作铺垫。

sampleVerse.text: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.

explanation.en: Mount Hermon is the high, snow-capped southern end of the Anti-Lebanon range and a northern landmark of the biblical land. Deuteronomy 3:9 preserves the Sidonian and Amorite names for the mountain, showing its importance across neighboring cultures.
explanation.zh: 黑门山是前黎巴嫩山脉南端高耸、积雪的山峰，也是圣经地区北方的重要地标。申命记3:9保存西顿人和亚摩利人对它的不同称呼，显示这座山对周边民族的重要。

sampleVerse.text: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)

explanation.en: Jabesh here means Jabesh-gilead, the town Saul once rescued from the Ammonites. First Samuel 31:13 records its people burying Saul and his sons after recovering their bodies, repaying that earlier deliverance with loyal honor.
explanation.zh: 这里的雅比指基列雅比，就是扫罗曾从亚扪人手中救出的城。撒母耳记上31:13记载居民取回扫罗和众子的遗体安葬，以忠诚尊荣回报昔日的拯救。

sampleVerse.text: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

explanation.en: Kedesh in Galilee was a fortified town of Naphtali and one of Israel's designated cities of refuge. Joshua 20:7 records it being set apart so an unintentional killer could receive due process and protection from immediate vengeance.
explanation.zh: 加利利的基低斯是拿弗他利的坚城，也是以色列指定的逃城之一。约书亚记20:7记载它被分别出来，使误杀人的人得到审理程序，并免于即时复仇。

sampleVerse.text: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.

explanation.en: The Kidron is the seasonal brook and valley between Jerusalem and the Mount of Olives. Second Samuel 15:23 records David crossing it while fleeing Absalom, a sorrowful route Jesus would later also take from Jerusalem.
explanation.zh: 汲沦是耶路撒冷与橄榄山之间的季节性溪流和谷地。撒母耳记下15:23记载大卫逃避押沙龙时渡过这里；后来耶稣离开耶路撒冷也走过这条悲伤的路。

sampleVerse.text: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.

explanation.en: Nahshon son of Amminadab was the wilderness-era leader of Judah and an ancestor of Boaz and David. Numbers 1:7 names him as Judah's representative in the census, placing the future royal line at the head of the tribe.
explanation.zh: 亚米拿达的儿子拿顺是旷野时期犹大支派的领袖，也是波阿斯和大卫的先祖。民数记1:7在数点人口时把他列为犹大的代表，使未来王族处在支派领导位置。

sampleVerse.text: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

explanation.en: Mount Nebo is the Moabite height east of the Jordan from which Moses viewed Canaan before his death. Deuteronomy 34:1 records God showing him the land from its summit, closing the wilderness journey without Moses crossing the river.
explanation.zh: 尼波山是约旦河东摩押境内的高地，摩西临死前从那里眺望迦南。申命记34:1记载上帝在山顶把那地指给他看，使旷野旅程结束，而摩西没有过河。

sampleVerse.text: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,

explanation.en: This Rechab was one of Ish-bosheth's captains and, with his brother Baanah, assassinated Saul's son while he rested. Second Samuel 4:5 records their approach to his house, beginning a murder David condemned rather than rewarded.
explanation.zh: 这里的利甲是伊施波设的军长之一，与兄弟巴拿趁扫罗的儿子休息时刺杀他。撒母耳记下4:5记载两人来到其家，开始一宗大卫后来谴责而非奖赏的谋杀。

sampleVerse.text: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ish-bosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.

explanation.en: Rezin was the last king of Aram-Damascus and allied with Pekah of Israel against Judah. Second Kings 16:5 records their siege of Jerusalem, the crisis that drove Ahaz toward a disastrous alliance with Assyria.
explanation.zh: 利汛是亚兰大马士革最后一位王，与以色列王比加结盟攻打犹大。列王纪下16:5记载他们围困耶路撒冷；这场危机促使亚哈斯与亚述结成灾难性的联盟。

sampleVerse.text: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

explanation.en: Vashti was the Persian queen before Esther, deposed after refusing the king's command to display herself at his banquet. Esther 1:12 records her refusal and the king's fury, setting in motion the search that brought Esther to the palace.
explanation.zh: 瓦实提是以斯帖之前的波斯王后，因拒绝王在宴席上叫她出来展示自己而被废。以斯帖记1:12记载她的拒绝和王的震怒，由此启动把以斯帖带入王宫的选后过程。

sampleVerse.text: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.

explanation.en: Beor was the father of Balaam, the diviner summoned by Moab's king Balak. Numbers 22:5 identifies Balaam through his father and hometown when messengers seek a curse against Israel.
explanation.zh: 比珥是术士巴兰的父亲；摩押王巴勒曾召巴兰前来。民数记22:5在使者请求咒诅以色列时，以父亲和家乡说明巴兰的身份。

sampleVerse.text: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:

explanation.en: Bethuel was Nahor and Milcah's son, Rebekah's father, and a relative of Abraham. Genesis 24:15 identifies Rebekah through him just as she arrives at the well, where her hospitality confirms the servant's prayer.
explanation.zh: 彼土利是拿鹤和密迦的儿子、利百加的父亲，也是亚伯拉罕的亲属。创世记24:15在利百加来到井旁时以父亲说明她的身份；她随后的好客回应了仆人的祷告。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

explanation.en: Deborah was a prophetess and judge who led Israel during Canaanite oppression and summoned Barak to battle. Judges 4:4 introduces her authority before the military victory celebrated in her song.
explanation.zh: 底波拉是女先知和士师，在迦南人压迫时期领导以色列，并召巴拉出战。士师记4:4在后来由她诗歌颂扬的军事胜利之前，先介绍她的权柄。

sampleVerse.text: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.

explanation.en: Gerar was a town and district on Canaan's southern edge ruled by a king titled Abimelech. Genesis 26:17 records Isaac leaving the city to camp in its valley after tension over his growing prosperity.
explanation.zh: 基拉耳是迦南南缘的城和地区，由称为亚比米勒的王统治。创世记26:17记载以撒因日益兴盛引发冲突后，离开城中，转到基拉耳谷扎营。

sampleVerse.text: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

explanation.en: Gershom was Moses' first son by Zipporah, born during Moses' exile in Midian. Exodus 2:22 connects his name with Moses' feeling of being a stranger in a foreign land.
explanation.zh: 革舜是摩西与西坡拉所生的长子，出生于摩西流亡米甸期间。出埃及记2:22把他的名字与摩西在异地作寄居者的感受相连。

sampleVerse.text: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.

explanation.en: Hadad was an Edomite prince who escaped Joab's slaughter, grew up in Egypt, and later opposed Solomon. First Kings 11:14 says the LORD raised him as an adversary, showing political trouble emerging during Solomon's unfaithfulness.
explanation.zh: 哈达是逃过约押杀戮、在埃及长大的以东王子，后来敌对所罗门。列王纪上11:14说耶和华兴起他作对头，显示所罗门不忠时政治祸患随之出现。

sampleVerse.text: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king's seed in Edom.

explanation.en: Hanun succeeded his father Nahash as king of Ammon and disastrously mistrusted David's condolence delegation. Second Samuel 10:4 records him humiliating the envoys, an insult that provoked war with Israel.
explanation.zh: 哈嫩继父亲拿辖作亚扪王，却灾难性地误解了大卫前来吊唁的使团。撒母耳记下10:4记载他羞辱使者，这项侮辱引发与以色列的战争。

sampleVerse.text: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

explanation.en: Hoshea was the last king of northern Israel, ruling under Assyrian pressure after conspiring against Pekah. Second Kings 17:6 records Samaria's fall and Israel's deportation during his reign, bringing the kingdom to an end.
explanation.zh: 何细亚是北国以色列最后一位王，在谋害比加后，于亚述压力下统治。列王纪下17:6记载他在位时撒玛利亚陷落、以色列人被掳，使北国终结。

sampleVerse.text: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

explanation.en: Obed was the son of Ruth and Boaz, the child through whom Naomi's family line and inheritance were restored. Ruth 4:17 names him as Jesse's father and David's grandfather, connecting a household rescue with Israel's royal story.
explanation.zh: 俄备得是路得和波阿斯的儿子，借着他的出生，拿俄米家族的谱系和产业得以恢复。路得记4:17称他为耶西的父亲、大卫的祖父，使一个家庭的救赎与以色列王族历史相连。

sampleVerse.text: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

explanation.en: Paran was the broad wilderness north of Sinai and south of Canaan through which Israel traveled. Numbers 10:12 records the cloud resting there after the people departed Sinai, beginning the next stage toward the promised land.
explanation.zh: 巴兰是西奈以北、迦南以南的广大旷野，以色列曾经过这里。民数记10:12记载百姓离开西奈后，云彩停在此地，开始前往应许之地的下一阶段。

sampleVerse.text: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

explanation.en: Pashur son of Immer was the temple's chief officer who opposed Jeremiah's message. Jeremiah 20:2 records him beating the prophet and placing him in the stocks, after which Jeremiah announces a new name and judgment for him.
explanation.zh: 音麦的儿子巴施户是圣殿的首要官员，反对耶利米的信息。耶利米书20:2记载他打先知并将其枷锁；随后耶利米为他另取一名并宣告审判。

sampleVerse.text: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the LORD.

explanation.en: Zoar was the small town near the Dead Sea to which Lot fled when Sodom and Gomorrah were judged. Genesis 19:23 records his arrival just before fire fell, making the town a temporary refuge granted in mercy.
explanation.zh: 琐珥是死海附近的小城，所多玛和蛾摩拉受审判时罗得逃到这里。创世记19:23记载他刚到达，火便降下，使这城成为出于怜悯所准许的暂时避难处。

sampleVerse.text: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

explanation.en: Dathan was a Reubenite who joined Korah and Abiram in rebellion against Moses and Aaron. Numbers 16:1 names the conspirators whose challenge ended when the earth swallowed their households.
explanation.zh: 大坍是流便人，与可拉、亚比兰一同背叛摩西和亚伦。民数记16:1列出这些谋反者；他们的挑战最终以地裂吞没其家告终。

sampleVerse.text: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:

explanation.en: Dibon was a town north of the Arnon in territory disputed among Amorites, Israelites, and Moabites. Numbers 32:34 lists it among the cities rebuilt by Gad after Israel acquired land east of Jordan.
explanation.zh: 底本是亚嫩河北方的城，亚摩利人、以色列人和摩押人曾先后争夺该地。民数记32:34把它列在以色列取得约旦河东土地后，由迦得支派重建的城市中。

sampleVerse.text: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

explanation.en: Ehud son of Gera was a left-handed Benjaminite whom God raised to deliver Israel from Moab's king Eglon. Judges 3:15 introduces him carrying Israel's tribute, the occasion he used to begin liberation.
explanation.zh: 基拉的儿子以笏是惯用左手的便雅悯人，上帝兴起他拯救以色列脱离摩押王伊矶伦。士师记3:15介绍他带着贡物前去，并利用这次机会开始解放。

sampleVerse.text: But when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.

explanation.en: Elihu son of Barachel was the youngest speaker in Job's debate and waited while the older friends spoke. Job 32:6 records his respectful hesitation before he offers a different, though still incomplete, account of suffering and divine justice.
explanation.zh: 巴拉迦的儿子以利户是约伯辩论中最年轻的发言者，先等年长朋友说完。约伯记32:6记载他带着尊重而迟疑，随后提出对苦难和神圣公义不同却仍不完整的解释。

sampleVerse.text: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.

explanation.en: Gaal son of Ebed became the champion of discontented Shechemites against Abimelech. Judges 9:26 records him and his relatives entering Shechem and gaining the citizens' confidence before their revolt failed.
explanation.zh: 以别的儿子迦勒成为示剑不满民众反对亚比米勒的领袖。士师记9:26记载他和亲属进入示剑，取得居民信任，但后来叛乱失败。

sampleVerse.text: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.

explanation.en: The Hivites were one of Canaan's peoples, living in places that included Gibeon and the region near Hermon. Joshua 9:7 identifies the Gibeonite delegation as Hivite while Israel questions whether a treaty with nearby inhabitants is lawful.
explanation.zh: 希未人是迦南民族之一，居住地包括基遍和黑门山附近。约书亚记9:7称基遍使团为希未人；以色列当时正质疑能否与近邻居民立约。

sampleVerse.text: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?

explanation.en: Hormah was a southern Canaanite site whose name is connected with devoting something to destruction. Numbers 21:3 records Israel defeating the Canaanite attackers and naming the place after the ban placed upon their cities.
explanation.zh: 何珥玛是迦南南部地点，名字与把某物完全毁灭归神有关。民数记21:3记载以色列击败来袭的迦南人，并按对其城邑所行的毁灭之令为此地命名。

sampleVerse.text: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.

explanation.en: Rome was the capital of the empire governing the Mediterranean world and the destination of Paul's appeal to Caesar. Acts 28:16 records him arriving there under guard yet allowed to live separately, from which confinement he continued witnessing.
explanation.zh: 罗马是统治地中海世界之帝国的首都，也是保罗向凯撒上诉后的目的地。使徒行传28:16记载他受看守抵达，却获准单独居住，并在拘禁中继续作见证。

sampleVerse.text: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.

explanation.en: Seth was Adam and Eve's son born after Abel's murder and ancestor of the line leading to Noah. Genesis 4:25 explains his name through Eve's gratitude that God appointed another offspring in Abel's place.
explanation.zh: 塞特是亚伯被杀后亚当和夏娃所生的儿子，也是通向挪亚之谱系的先祖。创世记4:25借夏娃的感恩解释他的名字：上帝另赐一个后裔代替亚伯。

sampleVerse.text: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.

explanation.en: Amos was a shepherd and dresser of sycamore figs from Tekoa whom God sent to prophesy against northern Israel's injustice. Amos 7:14 denies that he belonged to a professional prophetic guild, grounding his authority in God's call.
explanation.zh: 阿摩司是提哥亚的牧人和修理桑树果的人，上帝差他向北国以色列的不义发预言。阿摩司书7:14否认自己属于职业先知群体，把权柄建立在上帝的呼召上。

sampleVerse.text: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:

explanation.en: Anah was a Horite descendant of Seir and a clan chief in Edomite genealogy; several relatives shared the name. Genesis 36:20 places him among Seir's sons who inhabited the land before Esau's descendants dominated it.
explanation.zh: 亚拿是西珥后裔中的何利人，也是以东家谱里的族长；亲族中另有人同名。创世记36:20把他列在原先居住那地的西珥众子中，早于以扫后裔取得主导。

sampleVerse.text: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

explanation.en: The Arabah is the long, low rift valley extending along the Jordan and south from the Dead Sea. Joshua 18:18 uses it as a landmark while defining Benjamin's tribal boundary.
explanation.zh: 亚拉巴是沿约旦河并从死海向南延伸的狭长低洼裂谷。约书亚记18:18在划定便雅悯支派边界时，以它作为地理标志。

sampleVerse.text: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:

explanation.en: Dedan names Arabian trading peoples associated with descendants of both Cush and Abraham's son Jokshan. Ezekiel 27:20 lists Dedan among Tyre's commercial partners, supplying valuable saddlecloths or riding gear.
explanation.zh: 底但指阿拉伯贸易民族，与古实的后裔和亚伯拉罕之子约珊的后裔都有联系。以西结书27:20把底但列为推罗商贸伙伴，供应贵重的坐垫或骑乘用品。

sampleVerse.text: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.

explanation.en: Felix was the Roman governor of Judea who heard Paul's case and hoped to receive a bribe. Acts 24:25 records him trembling as Paul reasons about righteousness, self-control, and judgment, yet postponing a response.
explanation.zh: 腓力斯是审理保罗案件的罗马犹太巡抚，也曾盼望收受贿赂。使徒行传24:25记载保罗讲论公义、节制和将来审判时，他感到惧怕，却把回应推迟。

sampleVerse.text: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.

explanation.en: Geshur was a small Aramean kingdom east of the Sea of Galilee and the homeland of Absalom's mother. Second Samuel 13:38 records Absalom living there three years after fleeing David for Amnon's murder.
explanation.zh: 基述是加利利海东边的小亚兰王国，也是押沙龙母亲的故乡。撒母耳记下13:38记载押沙龙因杀暗嫩逃离大卫后，在那里住了三年。

sampleVerse.text: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

explanation.en: Joah son of Asaph was Hezekiah's recorder, a high official responsible for royal records and communication. Second Kings 18:18 names him among Judah's representatives who met the Assyrian spokesman outside Jerusalem.
explanation.zh: 亚萨的儿子约亚是希西家的史官，负责王室记录和传达事务。列王纪下18:18把他列在耶路撒冷城外会见亚述使者的犹大官员中。

sampleVerse.text: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.

explanation.en: Rahab was a woman of Jericho who sheltered Israelite spies, confessed faith in Israel's God, and joined the covenant people. Joshua 2:1 records the spies entering her house, where her courageous protection begins the story of her rescue.
explanation.zh: 喇合是耶利哥女子，藏匿以色列探子、承认以色列的上帝，并加入盟约百姓。约书亚记2:1记载探子进入她家；她勇敢的保护由此开始了自己得救的故事。

sampleVerse.text: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

explanation.en: Shebna was Hezekiah's proud palace steward who used his office for self-exaltation and prepared an impressive tomb. Isaiah 22:15 sends the prophet to confront him before announcing that Eliakim will replace him.
explanation.zh: 舍伯那是希西家骄傲的王宫管家，利用职权抬高自己，并为自己预备华丽坟墓。以赛亚书22:15差先知去责备他，随后宣告以利亚敬将取代其职。

sampleVerse.text: Thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,

explanation.en: Teman was an Edomite district and clan descended from Esau's grandson, renowned for wise counselors. Jeremiah 49:7 asks whether wisdom has vanished there as judgment approaches Edom.
explanation.zh: 提幔是以东地区和宗族，源自以扫的孙子，并以智慧谋士闻名。耶利米书49:7在审判临近以东时，反问当地的智慧是否已经消失。

sampleVerse.text: Concerning Edom, thus saith the LORD of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

explanation.en: Zorah was a Danite town in Judah's lowlands and the home of Samson's family. Judges 13:2 introduces Manoah and his childless wife there immediately before the angel announces Samson's birth.
explanation.zh: 琐拉是犹大低地的但支派城市，也是参孙一家的家乡。士师记13:2在天使宣告参孙出生前，先介绍住在那里的玛挪亚和不育的妻子。

sampleVerse.text: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.

explanation.en: Adullam was a Canaanite town in Judah's lowlands with nearby caves that provided refuge. First Samuel 22:1 records David escaping to its cave, where family members and distressed people gathered around him.
explanation.zh: 亚杜兰是犹大低地的迦南城，附近洞穴可供藏身。撒母耳记上22:1记载大卫逃进亚杜兰洞；家人和困苦的人随后聚集到他身边。

sampleVerse.text: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father's house heard it, they went down thither to him.

explanation.en: Ammihud was the father of Elishama, the Ephraimite leader appointed for Israel's wilderness census. Numbers 1:10 identifies him through his son among the representatives of Joseph's tribes.
explanation.zh: 亚米忽是以法莲领袖以利沙玛的父亲；以利沙玛受命参与旷野的人口数点。民数记1:10借儿子说明他的身份，把他列入约瑟支派代表的家系。

sampleVerse.text: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

explanation.en: Beriah was a son of Asher and ancestor of a clan that entered Israel's tribal genealogy. Genesis 46:17 lists him among Jacob's household connected with the descent into Egypt.
explanation.zh: 比利亚是亚设的儿子，也是进入以色列支派谱系之宗族的先祖。创世记46:17把他列在雅各下埃及的家族成员中。

sampleVerse.text: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.

explanation.en: Bozrah was a fortified Edomite city and the home of Jobab, an early king of Edom. Genesis 36:33 identifies it as Jobab's city when he succeeds Bela, preserving its place in Edom's pre-Israelite monarchy.
explanation.zh: 波斯拉是以东的坚城，也是早期以东王约巴的家乡。创世记36:33记载约巴继比拉作王时，以此城说明他的来处，保存了它在以色列立王前以东王国中的位置。

sampleVerse.text: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

explanation.en: Chaldea was southern Babylonia and, by extension, the Babylonian realm that conquered Judah. Jeremiah 50:10 foretells that the land which plundered others will itself become spoil under God's judgment.
explanation.zh: 迦勒底原指巴比伦南部，后来也泛指征服犹大的巴比伦国土。耶利米书50:10预告这个掠夺别人的国家自己也要成为掠物，受上帝审判。

sampleVerse.text: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD.

explanation.en: The Chebar was a Babylonian canal or river near which Judean exiles were settled. Ezekiel 1:1 records the heavens opening there for the prophet's vision, showing God's presence reaching his people even in exile.
explanation.zh: 迦巴鲁河是巴比伦境内的运河或河道，犹大被掳者定居在附近。以西结书1:1记载先知在那里看见天开了，显明上帝的同在即使在被掳之地也临到百姓。

sampleVerse.text: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

explanation.en: Chemosh was the national god of Moab, whose worship Scripture condemns as idolatry. First Kings 11:7 records Solomon building a high place for Chemosh near Jerusalem, evidence that foreign alliances corrupted his devotion.
explanation.zh: 基抹是摩押的民族神明，圣经谴责对它的敬拜为偶像崇拜。列王纪上11:7记载所罗门在耶路撒冷附近为基抹筑邱坛，证明外邦联盟败坏了他的忠诚。

sampleVerse.text: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.

explanation.en: Cilicia was the Roman province on southeastern Asia Minor's coast, with Tarsus as its leading city. Acts 22:3 records Paul identifying himself as born in Tarsus of Cilicia while explaining his Jewish education and calling.
explanation.zh: 基利家是小亚细亚东南海岸的罗马行省，大数是其主要城市。使徒行传22:3记载保罗在说明犹太教育与蒙召时，自称生于基利家的大数。

sampleVerse.text: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.

explanation.en: Dinah was Jacob and Leah's daughter, whose assault by Shechem was followed by deceitful and excessive revenge from her brothers. Genesis 34:2 states that Shechem took and violated her, making her the harmed person rather than the cause of the later violence.
explanation.zh: 底拿是雅各和利亚的女儿；她被示剑伤害后，兄弟又以欺骗和过度报复回应。创世记34:2说明示剑强行玷辱她，清楚表明她是受害者，并不是后来暴力的原因。

sampleVerse.text: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

explanation.en: Edrei was a principal city of Bashan and the battlefield where King Og confronted Israel. Numbers 21:33 records Og and his people marching there to battle, leading to the end of his kingdom.
explanation.zh: 以得来是巴珊的主要城市，也是噩王与以色列交战的战场。民数记21:33记载噩王率众在那里出战，结果他的王国终结。

sampleVerse.text: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

explanation.en: Hanani was a seer who rebuked Judah's King Asa for trusting Syria instead of the LORD. Second Chronicles 16:7 records his message that this political dependence cost Asa a fuller victory and brought continuing war.
explanation.zh: 哈拿尼是先见，责备犹大王亚撒倚靠叙利亚而不倚靠耶和华。历代志下16:7记载他指出，这种政治依赖使亚撒失去更完全的胜利，并带来持续战争。

sampleVerse.text: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the LORD thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.

explanation.en: Kenaz was the father or close ancestor of Othniel and belonged to the clan associated with Caleb. Judges 3:9 identifies Othniel through him when God raises Israel's first judge to deliver the people.
explanation.zh: 基纳斯是俄陀聂的父亲或近祖，属于与迦勒相关的宗族。士师记3:9在上帝兴起第一位士师拯救以色列时，以基纳斯说明俄陀聂的身份。

sampleVerse.text: And when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.

explanation.en: Mamre was an Amorite ally of Abraham and the name of the grove or district near Hebron where Abraham lived. Genesis 13:18 records him pitching his tent there and building an altar after God renewed the land promise.
explanation.zh: 幔利既是亚伯拉罕的亚摩利盟友，也指希伯仑附近亚伯拉罕居住的树林或地区。创世记13:18记载上帝重申土地应许后，他在那里支搭帐棚并筑坛。

sampleVerse.text: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.

explanation.en: Menahem seized Israel's throne by killing Shallum and ruled with notable cruelty. Second Kings 15:19 records him paying the Assyrian king Pul a huge tribute to secure royal power, increasing foreign control over Israel.
explanation.zh: 米拿现杀死沙龙夺取以色列王位，以残暴统治著称。列王纪下15:19记载他向亚述王普勒缴纳巨额贡银以巩固王权，加深外国对以色列的控制。

sampleVerse.text: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

explanation.en: The Millo was a filled or terraced fortification forming part of ancient Jerusalem's defenses. Second Samuel 5:9 says David built the captured stronghold outward from it as he established the city of David.
explanation.zh: 米罗是以填土或台地构成的防御设施，属于古耶路撒冷城防的一部分。撒母耳记下5:9说大卫攻取保障后，从米罗向外修筑，建立大卫城。

sampleVerse.text: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.

explanation.en: Molech was an Ammonite deity associated with the horrific sacrifice of children by fire. Leviticus 20:2 commands judgment on anyone who gives offspring to Molech, protecting covenant worship and condemning the killing of children.
explanation.zh: 摩洛是亚扪神明，与把儿童经火献祭的可怕做法有关。利未记20:2命令审判把儿女献给摩洛的人，既保护盟约敬拜，也谴责杀害儿童。

sampleVerse.text: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

explanation.en: Reuel was the Midianite priest and father of Zipporah, later identified within Moses' father-in-law's family; the related title Jethro is also used. Exodus 2:18 records his daughters returning after Moses defended and helped water their flock.
explanation.zh: 流珥是米甸祭司和西坡拉的父亲，属于摩西岳父的家庭；相关称号叶忒罗也用于这位长者。出埃及记2:18记载女儿们在摩西保护并帮助饮羊后回到父亲那里。

sampleVerse.text: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?

explanation.en: Tubal was a son of Japheth and the ancestor-name of a people north of the biblical Near East. Ezekiel 27:13 lists Tubal and Meshech trading with Tyre in enslaved persons and bronze vessels, exposing commerce that included human lives.
explanation.zh: 土巴是雅弗的儿子，也是圣经近东北方一个民族的祖先之名。以西结书27:13列出土巴和米设与推罗交易人口和铜器，揭露商业中也包括被奴役的人命。

sampleVerse.text: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.

explanation.en: Urijah was the high priest under King Ahaz who copied a foreign altar from Damascus at the king's command. Second Kings 16:16 records his compliance, showing priestly failure to resist royal corruption of temple worship.
explanation.zh: 乌利亚是亚哈斯王时期的大祭司，奉王命仿造大马士革的外邦祭坛。列王纪下16:16记载他完全照办，显出祭司没有抵抗王对圣殿敬拜的败坏。

sampleVerse.text: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.

explanation.en: Ziph was a town and wilderness district in Judah's hill country where David hid from Saul. First Samuel 23:19 records local Ziphites betraying his location to the king, though David escaped capture.
explanation.zh: 西弗是犹大山地的城和旷野地区，大卫曾在那里躲避扫罗。撒母耳记上23:19记载当地西弗人向王告密大卫的位置，但大卫仍逃脱追捕。

sampleVerse.text: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?

explanation.en: Aram was a son of Shem and the ancestral name of the Aramean peoples and lands later often called Syria. Genesis 10:22 places him in the post-flood genealogy alongside Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, and Lud.
explanation.zh: 亚兰是闪的儿子，也是后来常称为叙利亚之亚兰民族和土地的祖先名称。创世记10:22在洪水后的家谱中，把他与以拦、亚述、亚法撒和路德并列。

sampleVerse.text: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

explanation.en: Enos, also called Enosh, was Seth's son and Adam's grandson. Genesis 4:26 links his generation with people beginning to call upon the LORD's name, marking an early public identity of worship.
explanation.zh: 以挪士又称以挪士，是塞特的儿子、亚当的孙子。创世记4:26把他的世代与人开始求告耶和华的名相连，标志早期公开的敬拜身份。

sampleVerse.text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.

explanation.en: Immer was the ancestor-name of the sixteenth priestly division organized for temple service. First Chronicles 24:14 records that course in the ordered rotation established for Aaron's descendants.
explanation.zh: 音麦是圣殿事奉中第十六个祭司班次的祖先之名。历代志上24:14把这一班列入为亚伦后裔设立的有序轮值中。

sampleVerse.text: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

explanation.en: Matthew was a tax collector whom Jesus called to become one of the Twelve and who is traditionally associated with the Gospel bearing his name. Matthew 9:9 records him leaving the tax booth immediately to follow Jesus.
explanation.zh: 马太原是税吏，蒙耶稣呼召成为十二使徒之一，传统也把同名福音书与他相连。马太福音9:9记载他立即离开税关跟从耶稣。

sampleVerse.text: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.

explanation.en: Meshech was a son of Japheth and the ancestor-name of a northern people often mentioned with Tubal. Ezekiel 27:13 lists them among Tyre's traders in enslaved people and bronze, locating the nation in a morally complex trade network.
explanation.zh: 米设是雅弗的儿子，也是常与土巴并提之北方民族的祖先之名。以西结书27:13把他们列在推罗交易人口和铜器的商旅中，使这个民族处于道德复杂的贸易网络。

sampleVerse.text: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.

explanation.en: Peleg was Eber's son and an ancestor in the line leading to Abraham. Genesis 10:25 explains his name by saying the earth was divided in his days, commonly connected with the scattering of peoples.
explanation.zh: 法勒是希伯的儿子，也是通向亚伯拉罕之谱系的先祖。创世记10:25解释他的名字，说那时人就分地居住，通常与各民族分散相连。

sampleVerse.text: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.

explanation.en: Shinar was the plain of southern Mesopotamia associated with early Babylonian cities. Genesis 11:2 records the post-flood migrants settling there before building Babel's city and tower in collective pride.
explanation.zh: 示拿是美索不达米亚南部的平原，与早期巴比伦城市有关。创世记11:2记载洪水后迁移的人定居在那里，随后出于集体骄傲建造巴别城和塔。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

explanation.en: Adah was one of Lamech's two wives and the mother of Jabal and Jubal; another Adah later married Esau. Genesis 4:19 introduces Lamech's two marriages, the Bible's first recorded departure from the one-flesh marriage pattern.
explanation.zh: 亚大是拉麦两个妻子之一，也是雅八和犹八的母亲；后来以扫另有一位同名妻子。创世记4:19介绍拉麦的两段婚姻，是圣经第一次记载偏离一夫一妻、二人成为一体的婚姻模式。

sampleVerse.text: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

explanation.en: Arabia is the vast peninsula and desert region south and east of the biblical land, home to many tribal peoples. Galatians 1:17 says Paul went there after his calling before returning to Damascus, though it gives no details of that period.
explanation.zh: 阿拉伯是圣经地区南方和东方的广大半岛与旷野，居住着许多部族。加拉太书1:17说保罗蒙召后先到那里，随后回大马士革，但没有交代这段时期的细节。

sampleVerse.text: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.

explanation.en: Azekah was a fortified town in Judah's lowlands near the Valley of Elah. Joshua 10:11 records fleeing Amorite forces struck by great hailstones on the descent toward it, during Joshua's defense of Gibeon.
explanation.zh: 亚西加是犹大低地、靠近以拉谷的坚城。约书亚记10:11记载约书亚援救基遍时，逃往此城方向的亚摩利军在下坡路上被大冰雹击打。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Beth-horon, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.

explanation.en: Eshtaol was a Danite town near Zorah and part of Samson's home region. Judges 13:25 records the Spirit of the LORD beginning to move Samson in the camp between the two towns.
explanation.zh: 以实陶是靠近琐拉的但支派城市，属于参孙的家乡地区。士师记13:25记载耶和华的灵开始在两城之间的营地感动参孙。

sampleVerse.text: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.

explanation.en: Ezer was one of the Gadite warriors who crossed to join David at his wilderness stronghold. First Chronicles 12:9 names him as the chief among a group described as courageous and skilled in battle.
explanation.zh: 以薛是越过河流、到旷野保障投奔大卫的迦得勇士之一。历代志上12:9称他为这群勇敢善战之人的首领。

sampleVerse.text: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

explanation.en: Hepher was a son of Gilead and ancestor of a Manassite clan that included Zelophehad's daughters. Numbers 26:32 lists the Hepherites within Machir's descendants during Israel's second wilderness census.
explanation.zh: 希弗是基列的儿子，也是包括西罗非哈众女儿在内之玛拿西宗族的先祖。民数记26:32在以色列旷野第二次数点人口时，把希弗族列入玛吉的后裔。

sampleVerse.text: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

explanation.en: Ittai was a recent exile from Gath who led six hundred men and chose loyalty to David during Absalom's revolt. Second Samuel 15:21 records his oath to remain with the king whether it meant life or death.
explanation.zh: 以太是刚从迦特流亡而来、带领六百人的将领；押沙龙叛乱时，他选择忠于大卫。撒母耳记下15:21记载他起誓，无论生死都要与王同在。

sampleVerse.text: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As the LORD liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.

explanation.en: The Jabbok is a river flowing west through Gilead into the Jordan. Genesis 32:22 records Jacob sending his family across its ford on the night he wrestled and received the name Israel.
explanation.zh: 雅博河穿过基列向西流入约旦河。创世记32:22记载雅各在摔跤并得名以色列的那一夜，先让家人渡过这条河的渡口。

sampleVerse.text: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

explanation.en: Javan was Japheth's son and the Hebrew ancestral name associated with the Greeks or Ionians. Daniel 8:21 identifies the vision's goat as the king of Grecia, using this national name for the empire that followed Persia.
explanation.zh: 雅完是雅弗的儿子，也是与希腊人或爱奥尼亚人相连的希伯来祖先名称。但以理书8:21把异象中的公山羊解释为希腊王，用这个民族名称指接续波斯的帝国。

sampleVerse.text: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

explanation.en: Media was the Iranian highland kingdom joined with Persia in the empire that succeeded Babylon. Esther 1:3 places Median and Persian nobles together at Ahasuerus' royal feast, reflecting their shared imperial rule.
explanation.zh: 玛代是伊朗高地王国，与波斯结合组成接续巴比伦的帝国。以斯帖记1:3把玛代和波斯贵族一同列在亚哈随鲁王的宴席上，反映双方共同的帝国统治。

sampleVerse.text: In the third year of his reign, he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, being before him:

explanation.en: Shobal was a son of Seir and a Horite clan chief in the land later occupied by Edom. Genesis 36:20 lists him among the region's earlier inhabitants before Esau's descendants became dominant.
explanation.zh: 朔巴是西珥的儿子，也是后来以东所在地的一位何利族长。创世记36:20把他列在当地较早的居民中，时间在以扫后裔取得主导以前。

sampleVerse.text: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

explanation.en: Stephen was one of the Seven appointed in Jerusalem, a powerful witness, and the first recorded Christian martyr. Acts 7:60 records him praying for his killers and falling asleep in death, reflecting Christlike forgiveness and biblical resurrection hope.
explanation.zh: 司提反是耶路撒冷所选七人之一，是有力的见证人，也是圣经记载第一位基督徒殉道者。使徒行传7:60记载他为杀害自己的人祷告，并在死亡中睡去，显出基督般的赦免与复活盼望。

sampleVerse.text: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

explanation.en: Zoan was an ancient Egyptian city in the Nile Delta, also known as Tanis. Psalm 78:12 locates God's Exodus wonders in its field, using the famous city to represent Pharaoh's land.
explanation.zh: 琐安是尼罗河三角洲的古埃及城市，又称塔尼斯。诗篇78:12把出埃及的奇事定位在琐安田野，以这座名城代表法老的国土。

sampleVerse.text: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

explanation.en: Achan was an Israelite of Judah who secretly took goods devoted to destruction after Jericho's fall. Joshua 7:21 records his confession of coveting and hiding the spoil, a private sin that brought public defeat at Ai.
explanation.zh: 亚干是犹大支派的以色列人，在耶利哥陷落后私取当灭之物。约书亚记7:21记载他承认贪恋并藏匿战利品；这项私罪导致以色列在艾城公开战败。

sampleVerse.text: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.

explanation.en: Agag was the title or name of the Amalekite king whom Saul captured in battle. First Samuel 15:9 records Saul sparing him and the best livestock against God's command, an act of disobedience that cost Saul the dynasty.
explanation.zh: 亚甲是扫罗在战争中擒获之亚玛力王的名号或名字。撒母耳记上15:9记载扫罗违背上帝命令，留下他和上好牲畜；这项悖逆使扫罗失去王朝。

sampleVerse.text: But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

explanation.en: Ahinoam of Jezreel was one of David's wives and the mother of his firstborn son Amnon; another Ahinoam was Saul's wife. First Samuel 25:43 records David marrying her alongside Abigail during his years away from Saul's court.
explanation.zh: 耶斯列人亚希暖是大卫的妻子之一，也是长子暗嫩的母亲；扫罗的妻子另有一位同名者。撒母耳记上25:43记载大卫离开扫罗宫廷期间娶她，并同时提到亚比该。

sampleVerse.text: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.

explanation.en: Akkub was the name of a temple gatekeeper family that served after the exile, as well as other biblical individuals. First Chronicles 9:17 lists Akkub among the chief porters responsible for guarded access in Jerusalem.
explanation.zh: 亚谷是被掳归回后担任圣殿守门之宗族的名称，也有其他圣经人物同名。历代志上9:17把亚谷列在负责守护耶路撒冷出入口的主要守门者中。

sampleVerse.text: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;

explanation.en: Asshur was a son of Shem and the ancestor-name linked with Assyria and its earliest cities. Genesis 10:22 places him in Shem's family line alongside Elam and Aram.
explanation.zh: 亚述是闪的儿子，也是与亚述民族及其早期城市相连的祖先名称。创世记10:22把他与以拦、亚兰等一同列在闪的家谱中。

sampleVerse.text: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

explanation.en: Jared was an early patriarch in Seth's line and the father of Enoch. Genesis 5:18 records Enoch's birth when Jared was 162, preserving the genealogy that leads from Adam to Noah.
explanation.zh: 雅列是塞特谱系中的早期先祖，也是以诺的父亲。创世记5:18记载雅列一百六十二岁生以诺，保存了从亚当通向挪亚的家谱。

sampleVerse.text: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:

explanation.en: Jarmuth was a Canaanite royal city in Judah's lowlands. Joshua 10:3 names its king Piram among the five Amorite rulers summoned to attack Gibeon after its treaty with Israel.
explanation.zh: 耶末是犹大低地的迦南王城。约书亚记10:3把耶末王毗兰列在五位亚摩利王中；他们因基遍与以色列立约而联合进攻。

sampleVerse.text: Wherefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,

explanation.en: Ophrah of the Abiezrites was Gideon's hometown in Manasseh and the location of his father's oak and altar. Judges 6:11 records the angel of the LORD finding Gideon there, secretly threshing wheat because of Midian.
explanation.zh: 亚比以谢人的俄弗拉是基甸在玛拿西的家乡，也是他父亲的橡树和祭坛所在地。士师记6:11记载耶和华的使者在那里找到基甸；他因米甸人的威胁正暗中打麦。

sampleVerse.text: And there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.

explanation.en: Othniel son of Kenaz and relative of Caleb was the first judge raised after Joshua's generation. Judges 3:9 says God raised him to deliver Israel after the people cried out under Mesopotamian oppression.
explanation.zh: 基纳斯的儿子、迦勒亲属俄陀聂，是约书亚世代后兴起的第一位士师。士师记3:9说百姓在美索不达米亚压迫下呼求，上帝便兴起他拯救以色列。

sampleVerse.text: And when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.

explanation.en: Penuel, also called Peniel, is the site by the Jabbok where Jacob wrestled through the night. Genesis 32:30 explains its name, 'face of God,' through Jacob's testimony that he saw God face to face and lived.
explanation.zh: 毗努伊勒又称毗尼伊勒，是雅各在雅博河边整夜摔跤的地点。创世记32:30借雅各称自己面对面见了上帝仍得存活，解释此名意为“上帝之面”。

sampleVerse.text: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

explanation.en: Rehum was the Persian provincial chancellor who helped compose an accusation against Jerusalem's rebuilding. Ezra 4:8 introduces his letter to Artaxerxes, which temporarily halted the work through imperial order.
explanation.zh: 利宏是波斯地方行政长官，参与撰写控告耶路撒冷重建的奏文。以斯拉记4:8介绍他给亚达薛西王的信；这封信借帝国命令暂时停止工程。

sampleVerse.text: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:

explanation.en: Shammah son of Agee was one of David's three outstanding mighty men. Second Samuel 23:11 records him standing in a lentil field abandoned by Israel and defending it against the Philistines.
explanation.zh: 亚基的儿子沙玛是大卫三位杰出勇士之一。撒母耳记下23:11记载以色列人逃跑时，他独守一块红豆田，抵挡非利士人。

sampleVerse.text: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.

explanation.en: Shishak was the Egyptian pharaoh who invaded Judah early in Rehoboam's reign. First Kings 14:25 records his advance against Jerusalem, which stripped wealth from the temple and palace after Judah's unfaithfulness.
explanation.zh: 示撒是罗波安统治初期入侵犹大的埃及法老。列王纪上14:25记载他进攻耶路撒冷；犹大不忠之后，圣殿和王宫的财富被夺。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:

explanation.en: Taanach was an ancient Canaanite city near Megiddo on the edge of the Jezreel Valley. Judges 5:19 places the battle against Sisera's coalition by its waters, where Canaanite kings fought without gaining spoil.
explanation.zh: 他纳是靠近米吉多、位于耶斯列谷边缘的古迦南城。士师记5:19把与西西拉联盟的战役定位在他纳水边；迦南诸王在那里作战，却没有掠得财物。

sampleVerse.text: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.

explanation.en: Tekoa was a Judean town south of Bethlehem, known for shepherding and as the home of Amos. Amos 1:1 introduces the prophet among its herdsmen before dating his visions concerning Israel.
explanation.zh: 提哥亚是伯利恒以南的犹大城，以牧养闻名，也是阿摩司的家乡。阿摩司书1:1先称先知为当地牧人，再说明他有关以色列之异象的年代。

sampleVerse.text: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

explanation.en: Timnah was a town in the border country between Judah and Philistia, occupied by Philistines in Samson's day. Judges 14:1 records Samson seeing a Philistine woman there, beginning a troubled marriage entangled with his conflict against them.
explanation.zh: 亭拿是犹大与非利士交界地区的城，参孙时代由非利士人占据。士师记14:1记载参孙在那里看见一位非利士女子，由此开始一段与双方冲突纠缠的婚姻。

sampleVerse.text: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.
