explanation.en: Aquila was a Jewish tentmaker from Pontus who served the gospel with his wife Priscilla. Acts 18:2 records Paul meeting the couple in Corinth after Claudius expelled Jews from Rome, beginning a lasting ministry partnership.
explanation.zh: 亚居拉是来自本都的犹太制帐棚者，与妻子百基拉一同服事福音。使徒行传18:2记载革老丢驱逐罗马犹太人后，保罗在哥林多遇见他们，由此开始长久同工。

sampleVerse.text: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.

explanation.en: Beeroth was one of four Hivite cities belonging to the Gibeonite league, later included in Benjamin's territory. Joshua 9:17 records Israel reaching it three days after discovering the delegation's deceptive claim of distant origin.
explanation.zh: 比录是基遍联盟四座希未人城市之一，后来归便雅悯境内。约书亚记9:17记载以色列发现使团假称来自远方后，第三天到达此城。

sampleVerse.text: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.

explanation.en: Corinth was a wealthy Roman city controlling trade across the isthmus of southern Greece and known for religious and moral diversity. Acts 18:1 records Paul arriving there from Athens, beginning an eighteen-month ministry and the church later addressed in two letters.
explanation.zh: 哥林多是控制希腊南部地峡贸易的富裕罗马城市，以宗教和道德环境复杂著称。使徒行传18:1记载保罗从雅典来到这里，开始十八个月的事工，并建立后来收到两封书信的教会。

sampleVerse.text: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;

explanation.en: Delilah was a woman of the Sorek Valley whom Philistine rulers bribed to discover the source of Samson's strength. Judges 16:5 records their offer, setting up her repeated manipulation and Samson's eventual capture.
explanation.zh: 大利拉是梭烈谷的女子，非利士首领贿赂她探出参孙力量的秘密。士师记16:5记载他们的出价，由此展开她反复操纵参孙并最终使他被捕的过程。

sampleVerse.text: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength lieth, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him: and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver.

explanation.en: Engedi is a freshwater oasis in the cliffs west of the Dead Sea, surrounded by the wilderness where David hid. First Samuel 24:1 records Saul pursuing him there, before David spares the king in a cave.
explanation.zh: 隐基底是死海西岸峭壁中的淡水绿洲，周围旷野曾是大卫藏身之地。撒母耳记上24:1记载扫罗在那里追赶大卫，随后大卫却在洞中饶了王。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.

explanation.en: Galatia was a region and Roman province in central Asia Minor where Paul established several congregations. Galatians 1:2 addresses its churches collectively before confronting teaching that made Gentile believers depend on circumcision for acceptance.
explanation.zh: 加拉太是小亚细亚中部地区和罗马行省，保罗在那里建立数个教会。加拉太书1:2向众教会共同致意，随后反驳使外邦信徒靠割礼才蒙接纳的教导。

sampleVerse.text: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

explanation.en: Goliath was the heavily armed Philistine champion from Gath who challenged Israel for forty days. First Samuel 17:4 introduces his extraordinary stature before David defeats him by trusting the LORD with a sling and stone.
explanation.zh: 歌利亚是来自迦特、全副武装的非利士勇士，向以色列挑战四十天。撒母耳记上17:4先介绍他非凡的身量，随后大卫倚靠耶和华，以机弦和石子击败他。

sampleVerse.text: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.

explanation.en: Iconium was a city of Lycaonia in Asia Minor visited by Paul and Barnabas on their first missionary journey. Acts 14:1 records them preaching in its synagogue with such effect that many Jews and Greeks believed.
explanation.zh: 以哥念是小亚细亚吕高尼的城市，保罗和巴拿巴第一次宣教旅程曾到访。使徒行传14:1记载他们在当地会堂讲道，许多犹太人和希腊人因此相信。

sampleVerse.text: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.

explanation.en: Jael was the wife of Heber the Kenite who received the fleeing Canaanite commander Sisera into her tent. Judges 4:21 records her killing him with a tent peg while he slept, decisively ending the threat within the story's wartime setting.
explanation.zh: 雅亿是基尼人希百的妻子，把逃亡的迦南元帅西西拉接入帐棚。士师记4:21记载她趁他熟睡，用帐棚橛杀死他，在战争背景中决定性地终结威胁。

sampleVerse.text: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

explanation.en: Joktan was Eber's son and ancestor of thirteen clans associated with southern Arabia. Genesis 10:26 begins listing his sons in the table of nations, locating Arabian peoples within the wider human family.
explanation.zh: 约坍是希伯的儿子，也是与南阿拉伯有关之十三个宗族的先祖。创世记10:26开始列出他的众子，在列国谱系中把阿拉伯民族置于整个人类大家庭。

sampleVerse.text: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

explanation.en: Lystra was a Lycaonian town where Paul preached, was mistaken for a god, and was later stoned by opponents. Acts 14:8 introduces a man unable to walk from birth whom Paul healed, triggering the crowd's misguided worship.
explanation.zh: 路司得是吕高尼城市；保罗在那里传道，被误认为神明，后来又被反对者用石头打。使徒行传14:8介绍一位生来不能行走的人，保罗医治他后，群众却错误地敬拜使徒。

sampleVerse.text: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:

explanation.en: Salmon was Nahshon's son, Boaz's father, and an ancestor in the line leading to David and Jesus. Ruth 4:20 places him in the genealogy that connects Judah's wilderness leadership with the restored family of Ruth.
explanation.zh: 撒门是拿顺的儿子、波阿斯的父亲，也是通向大卫和耶稣之谱系的先祖。路得记4:20把他列在家谱中，使旷野时代犹大的领袖家系与路得得恢复的家庭相连。

sampleVerse.text: And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,

explanation.en: Shur was the wilderness along Egypt's northeastern frontier between the Red Sea and southern Canaan. Exodus 15:22 records Israel entering it after crossing the sea and traveling three days without finding water.
explanation.zh: 书珥是埃及东北边界、位于红海与迦南南部之间的旷野。出埃及记15:22记载以色列过海后进入那里，走了三天却找不到水。

sampleVerse.text: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

explanation.en: Troas was a port of northwestern Asia Minor near ancient Troy and a crossroads for travel to Europe. Acts 16:9 records Paul's Macedonian vision there, redirecting the mission across the Aegean Sea.
explanation.zh: 特罗亚是小亚细亚西北部、靠近古特洛伊的港口，也是通往欧洲的交通节点。使徒行传16:9记载保罗在那里看见马其顿异象，使宣教方向转向爱琴海彼岸。

sampleVerse.text: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

explanation.en: Uzzah was Abinadab's son and helped drive the cart carrying the ark toward Jerusalem. Second Samuel 6:7 records his death after touching the ark when the oxen stumbled, exposing the danger of moving God's holy symbol contrary to given instructions.
explanation.zh: 乌撒是亚比拿达的儿子，协助用车把约柜运往耶路撒冷。撒母耳记下6:7记载牛失前蹄时他伸手扶柜而死，显出违背既定指示搬运上帝圣物的危险。

sampleVerse.text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.

explanation.en: Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the appointed leader representing the tribe of Dan in the wilderness. Numbers 1:12 names him among those assisting Moses and Aaron with Israel's census.
explanation.zh: 亚米沙代的儿子亚希以谢是旷野时期代表但支派的领袖。民数记1:12把他列在协助摩西和亚伦数点以色列的人中。

sampleVerse.text: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

explanation.en: Bahurim was a village on the road east from Jerusalem toward the Jordan Valley. Second Samuel 16:5 records Shimei coming from there to curse and stone David as the king fled Absalom.
explanation.zh: 巴户琳是从耶路撒冷向东通往约旦谷道路上的村庄。撒母耳记下16:5记载大卫逃避押沙龙时，示每从那里出来咒骂并向王扔石头。

sampleVerse.text: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.

explanation.en: Gihon was Jerusalem's principal spring and a crucial water source on the city's eastern side; the same name also belongs to an Eden river. First Kings 1:38 records Solomon being taken to the spring for public anointing as king.
explanation.zh: 基训是耶路撒冷东侧的主要泉源，对城市供水极重要；伊甸的一条河也使用同名。列王纪上1:38记载所罗门被带到泉旁，公开受膏为王。

sampleVerse.text: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.

explanation.en: The Kishon is a seasonal river draining the Jezreel Valley past Mount Carmel to the Mediterranean. Judges 5:21 poetically says its torrent swept away Sisera's forces during Deborah and Barak's victory.
explanation.zh: 基顺河是流经耶斯列谷、经过迦密山入地中海的季节性河流。士师记5:21以诗歌说急流冲没西西拉的军队，描写底波拉和巴拉的胜利。

sampleVerse.text: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.

explanation.en: Naioth was the community or dwellings of prophets associated with Samuel at Ramah. First Samuel 19:18 records David fleeing there to tell Samuel of Saul's attempt on his life and finding temporary refuge.
explanation.zh: 拿约是拉玛附近与撒母耳有关的先知群体或住处。撒母耳记上19:18记载大卫逃到那里，把扫罗企图杀他的事告诉撒母耳，并得到暂时庇护。

sampleVerse.text: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.

explanation.en: Zebul was Abimelech's governor in Shechem who secretly remained loyal when Gaal stirred rebellion. Judges 9:30 records his anger on hearing Gaal's speech, after which he warned Abimelech and arranged a counterattack.
explanation.zh: 西布勒是亚比米勒派在示剑的城宰；迦勒煽动叛乱时，他仍暗中效忠。士师记9:30记载他听见迦勒的话便发怒，随后通知亚比米勒并安排反击。

sampleVerse.text: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.

explanation.en: Abishag was a young woman from Shunem chosen to care for the aged King David and keep him warm. First Kings 1:3 records the search that brought her to court; after David's death, Adonijah's request for her carried a claim to royal status.
explanation.zh: 亚比煞是来自书念的年轻女子，被选来照顾年老的大卫王、为他取暖。列王纪上1:3记载寻找并把她带入宫廷；大卫死后，亚多尼雅求娶她的请求也带有争夺王位的意味。

sampleVerse.text: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

explanation.en: Admah was one of the cities of the Jordan plain destroyed with Sodom and Gomorrah. Deuteronomy 29:23 recalls its sulphur, salt, and barrenness as a warning of covenant judgment upon persistent rebellion.
explanation.zh: 押玛是约旦平原诸城之一，与所多玛、蛾摩拉一同毁灭。申命记29:23以硫磺、盐碱和不毛之地回顾它，作为持续背叛盟约所受审判的警戒。

sampleVerse.text: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:

explanation.en: Arpad was a fortified Syrian city near Hamath conquered by Assyria. Second Kings 18:34 places it in the Assyrian envoy's boast that no local gods had saved their cities, a claim he wrongly extended against the LORD.
explanation.zh: 亚珥拔是哈马附近的叙利亚坚城，曾被亚述征服。列王纪下18:34把它列入亚述使者的夸口：当地神明都未能救城；他又错误地把同样说法用于耶和华。

sampleVerse.text: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?

explanation.en: Athens was the famous Greek center of philosophy, art, and civic religion. Acts 17:22 records Paul addressing its council after observing many objects of worship, using their altar to an unknown god to proclaim the Creator.
explanation.zh: 雅典是著名的希腊哲学、艺术和城邦宗教中心。使徒行传17:22记载保罗观察许多敬拜对象后向议会讲话，借“未识之神”的坛宣讲创造主。

sampleVerse.text: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

explanation.en: Bildad the Shuhite was one of Job's three friends, whose rigid defense of retribution wrongly implied that Job's suffering proved guilt. Job 42:9 records him obeying God's command to offer sacrifice while Job prays for the friends.
explanation.zh: 书亚人比勒达是约伯三位朋友之一；他僵硬维护报应原则，错误暗示约伯受苦就证明有罪。约伯记42:9记载他遵照上帝命令献祭，并由约伯为朋友祷告。

sampleVerse.text: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD commanded them: the LORD also accepted Job.

explanation.en: Crete is a large Mediterranean island where Paul and his coworkers established Christian communities. Titus 1:5 says Paul left Titus there to organize unfinished work and appoint elders in every city.
explanation.zh: 克里特是地中海大岛，保罗和同工在那里建立基督徒群体。提多书1:5说保罗留下提多完成未办之事，并在各城设立长老。

sampleVerse.text: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:

explanation.en: Cyrene was a North African Greek city with a significant Jewish population. Matthew 27:32 identifies Simon of Cyrene as the passerby compelled to carry Jesus' cross on the way to execution.
explanation.zh: 古利奈是北非的希腊城市，居住着相当数量的犹太人。马太福音27:32认出古利奈人西门就是被迫在耶稣赴刑场路上背十字架的路人。

sampleVerse.text: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.

explanation.en: Diana is the KJV's Roman name for Artemis, the goddess whose great Ephesian temple supported civic pride and commerce. Acts 19:28 records artisans shouting her greatness when Paul's message threatened the idol trade.
explanation.zh: Diana 是 KJV 对亚底米女神采用的罗马名称；她在以弗所的大庙支撑城市荣誉和商业。使徒行传19:28记载保罗的信息威胁偶像生意时，工匠高喊女神伟大。

sampleVerse.text: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

explanation.en: Elealeh was a pastoral town east of Jordan near Heshbon, first rebuilt by the tribe of Reuben. Numbers 32:37 lists it among Reubenite settlements before later prophets lamented its Moabite population.
explanation.zh: 以利亚利是约旦河东、靠近希实本的牧区城镇，最初由流便支派重建。民数记32:37把它列在流便人的聚落中；后来先知又为居住其中的摩押人哀哭。

sampleVerse.text: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,

explanation.en: Gozan was a Mesopotamian region on the Habor river where Assyria resettled conquered peoples. Second Kings 17:6 names it among the destinations of Israelites deported after Samaria fell.
explanation.zh: 歌散是美索不达米亚哈博河一带，亚述把被征服民族迁往那里。列王纪下17:6把它列在撒玛利亚陷落后以色列被掳者的安置地中。

sampleVerse.text: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

explanation.en: Haggith was one of David's wives and the mother of his son Adonijah. Second Samuel 3:4 identifies her in the list of sons born during David's reign at Hebron, before Adonijah later sought the throne.
explanation.zh: 哈及是大卫的妻子之一，也是儿子亚多尼雅的母亲。撒母耳记下3:4在大卫统治希伯仑时所生众子中介绍她，时间早于亚多尼雅后来争夺王位。

sampleVerse.text: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

explanation.en: Hophni was one of Eli's priestly sons whose abuse of sacrifice and worship brought judgment on the household. First Samuel 2:12 calls Hophni and Phinehas sons of Belial who did not know the LORD, despite holding sacred office.
explanation.zh: 何弗尼是祭司以利的儿子之一；他滥用献祭和敬拜，使全家受到审判。撒母耳记上2:12称何弗尼和非尼哈为不认识耶和华的恶人，尽管他们身居圣职。

sampleVerse.text: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not the LORD.

explanation.en: Jahaz was the town or battlefield east of Jordan where Amorite King Sihon opposed Israel's passage. Deuteronomy 2:32 records him deploying his whole force there, leading to his defeat and Israel's acquisition of the territory.
explanation.zh: 雅杂是约旦河东的城或战场，亚摩利王西宏在那里阻挡以色列通行。申命记2:32记载他率全军布阵，结果战败，以色列取得其领土。

sampleVerse.text: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

explanation.en: Jason was a Thessalonian believer who hosted Paul and Silas during their mission. Acts 17:5 records a hostile crowd attacking his house when they could not find the missionaries, making him bear the public cost of hospitality.
explanation.zh: 耶孙是帖撒罗尼迦的信徒，在保罗和西拉传道期间接待他们。使徒行传17:5记载敌对群众找不到宣教士，便袭击他的家，使他为好客公开付出代价。

sampleVerse.text: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.

explanation.en: Magog first names a descendant of Japheth and later symbolizes nations gathered in final rebellion against God. Revelation 20:8 uses Gog and Magog for the deceived forces surrounding God's people before fire destroys the rebellion and evil ends.
explanation.zh: 玛各起初是雅弗的后裔名称，后来象征末后聚集反抗上帝的列国。启示录20:8以歌革和玛各称受迷惑、包围上帝百姓的势力；随后火毁灭叛乱，罪恶终结。

sampleVerse.text: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.

explanation.en: Medeba was an ancient plateau town east of the Dead Sea, controlled at different times by Moab and Reuben. Numbers 21:30 includes it in a poem describing the collapse of Sihon's Amorite territory before Israel.
explanation.zh: 米底巴是死海以东高原上的古城，先后由摩押和流便控制。民数记21:30在一首描述西宏亚摩利领土败于以色列的诗中提到它。

sampleVerse.text: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.

explanation.en: Migdol means tower and here names a fortified Egyptian location near Israel's camp by the Red Sea. Exodus 14:2 places the people between Migdol and the sea, where apparent entrapment became the setting for divine deliverance.
explanation.zh: 密夺意为“塔”，这里指以色列在红海边扎营附近的埃及防御地点。出埃及记14:2把百姓置于密夺与海之间；看似被困的处境成为上帝施行拯救的舞台。

sampleVerse.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baal-zephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.

explanation.en: Ophel was the fortified southern rise of Jerusalem's temple hill above the Kidron Valley. Nehemiah 3:26 records temple servants living there while participating in rebuilding the nearby wall.
explanation.zh: 俄斐勒是耶路撒冷圣殿山南部、俯瞰汲沦谷的坚固高地。尼希米记3:26记载殿役住在那里，并参与重建附近城墙。

sampleVerse.text: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, unto the place over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that lieth out.

explanation.en: Pathros is the biblical name for Upper Egypt, the southern Nile region around Thebes. Ezekiel 29:14 foretells displaced Egyptians returning there while Egypt is restored only as a lowly kingdom.
explanation.zh: 巴忒罗是上埃及的圣经名称，指以底比斯为中心的尼罗河南部地区。以西结书29:14预言分散的埃及人回到那里，但埃及恢复后只成为低微国家。

sampleVerse.text: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.

explanation.en: Pisgah is a ridge or summit in Moab's Abarim mountains overlooking the Jordan Valley and Canaan. Deuteronomy 3:27 tells Moses to view the land from there because he would not cross the Jordan.
explanation.zh: 毗斯迦是摩押亚巴琳山脉中的山脊或峰顶，可以俯瞰约旦谷和迦南。申命记3:27吩咐摩西从那里观看那地，因为他不能过约旦河。

sampleVerse.text: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

explanation.en: Talmon was a Levitical gatekeeper whose descendants continued guarding temple entrances after the exile. First Chronicles 9:17 names him with Shallum, Akkub, and Ahiman among Jerusalem's porters.
explanation.zh: 达们是利未守门者；被掳归回后，他的后裔继续看守圣殿入口。历代志上9:17把他与沙龙、亚谷和亚希幔一同列在耶路撒冷守门人中。

sampleVerse.text: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;

explanation.en: Tarsus was the prosperous Cilician city where Paul was born, known for trade and learning. Acts 9:11 directs Ananias to seek Saul of Tarsus after the Damascus-road encounter, linking the future apostle with his home city.
explanation.zh: 大数是保罗出生的基利家繁荣城市，以贸易和学术闻名。使徒行传9:11在大马士革路上的相遇后，指示亚拿尼亚寻找大数人扫罗，把未来使徒与家乡相连。

sampleVerse.text: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

explanation.en: Abarim is the mountain range east of the Dead Sea in Moab, including Nebo and Pisgah. Numbers 27:12 sends Moses up into these heights to see the land Israel would receive before his death.
explanation.zh: 亚巴琳是死海以东摩押境内的山脉，包括尼波和毗斯迦。民数记27:12差摩西登上这些高地，在离世前观看以色列将承受的土地。

sampleVerse.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.

explanation.en: Jebus was the Jebusite stronghold that occupied the site later known as Jerusalem. First Chronicles 11:4 records David and Israel moving against it, after which the captured fortress became the city of David.
explanation.zh: 耶布斯是耶布斯人在后来称为耶路撒冷之地点所建的保障。历代志上11:4记载大卫和以色列进攻此城；攻取后，堡垒成为大卫城。

sampleVerse.text: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.

explanation.en: Memphis was the ancient capital of Lower Egypt, called Moph or Noph in several KJV passages. Hosea 9:6 pictures it burying Israelite exiles who flee to Egypt, turning hoped-for refuge into a place of death.
explanation.zh: 孟斐斯是下埃及古都，在 KJV 若干经文中称摩弗或挪弗。何西阿书9:6描写它埋葬逃往埃及的以色列流亡者，使所盼望的避难地变成死亡之处。

sampleVerse.text: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.

explanation.en: Sibmah was a town near Heshbon on Moab's plateau, celebrated for far-reaching vineyards. Isaiah 16:9 laments those vines under judgment, using their destruction to portray Moab's loss of prosperity.
explanation.zh: 西比玛是摩押高原上靠近希实本的城，以广布的葡萄园闻名。以赛亚书16:9为审判中的葡萄树哀哭，用其毁坏描绘摩押繁荣的丧失。

sampleVerse.text: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.

explanation.en: Abiel was the father of Ner and thus an ancestor of both Saul and his commander Abner. First Samuel 14:51 preserves this Benjaminite family connection while explaining the kinship within Saul's court.
explanation.zh: 亚别是尼珥的父亲，因此也是扫罗和元帅押尼珥的先祖。撒母耳记上14:51保存这层便雅悯家族关系，解释扫罗宫廷中的亲属联系。

sampleVerse.text: And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

explanation.en: Greece in Acts 20 refers to the Roman province of Achaia in southern Greece, where Corinth was located. Acts 20:2 records Paul spending three months there after strengthening believers through Macedonia.
explanation.zh: 使徒行传20章的希腊指希腊南部罗马行省亚该亚，哥林多位于其中。使徒行传20:2记载保罗经过马其顿坚固信徒后，在那里停留三个月。

sampleVerse.text: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,

explanation.en: Saron, or Sharon, is the fertile coastal plain between Joppa and Mount Carmel. Acts 9:35 says its inhabitants turned to the Lord after seeing Aeneas healed through Peter's ministry at Lydda.
explanation.zh: 沙仑是约帕与迦密山之间肥沃的沿海平原。使徒行传9:35说当地居民看见彼得在吕大使以尼雅得医治后，便归向主。

sampleVerse.text: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.

explanation.en: Zeboiim was one of the cities of the Jordan plain destroyed with Sodom, Gomorrah, and Admah. Deuteronomy 29:23 recalls its barren overthrow as a warning of what covenant rebellion produces.
explanation.zh: 洗扁是约旦平原诸城之一，与所多玛、蛾摩拉和押玛一同毁灭。申命记29:23回顾它被倾覆后的荒凉，警告背叛盟约所产生的后果。

sampleVerse.text: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:

explanation.en: James son of Zebedee was John's brother, one of the Twelve, and part of Jesus' closest disciple group. Acts 12:2 records Herod killing him with the sword, making him the first apostle whose martyrdom is narrated.
explanation.zh: 西庇太的儿子雅各是约翰的兄弟、十二使徒之一，也属于耶稣最亲近的门徒群体。使徒行传12:2记载希律用刀杀他，使他成为圣经叙述中第一位殉道的使徒。

sampleVerse.text: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

explanation.en: A palace is the residence and administrative complex of a king, containing courts, halls, and guarded chambers. Esther 1:2 places Ahasuerus on his throne in Shushan's palace, the imperial setting where Esther's story unfolds.
explanation.zh: 宫殿是君王居住和处理政务的建筑群，包含院落、大厅和受守卫的房间。以斯帖记1:2把亚哈随鲁安置在书珊宫中的王位上，确立以斯帖故事展开的帝国背景。

sampleVerse.text: That in those days, when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Shushan the palace,

explanation.en: An apostle is one commissioned and sent as an authorized messenger; Jesus uniquely appointed the Twelve as foundational witnesses. Mark 3:14 says he chose them to be with him and to be sent out to preach, joining relationship, training, and mission.
explanation.zh: 使徒是受委任差遣、带着权柄传信的人；耶稣特别设立十二人作奠基性的见证者。马可福音3:14说祂选他们常与自己同在，又差他们出去传道，把关系、训练和使命结合起来。

sampleVerse.text: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

explanation.en: A shield is defensive armor carried to turn aside weapons and becomes an image of protection and trust. Psalm 3:3 calls the LORD David's shield, glory, and lifter of his head while enemies surround him.
explanation.zh: 盾牌是用来挡开武器的防御装备，也成为保护与信靠的象征。诗篇3:3在仇敌包围大卫时，称耶和华为他的盾牌、荣耀和使他抬起头的主。

sampleVerse.text: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

explanation.en: The Flood was the catastrophic judgment in Noah's day through which the ark preserved one household and representatives of land animals. Genesis 7:17 records waters increasing and lifting the ark above the earth during forty days of rain.
explanation.zh: 洪水是挪亚时代的灾难性审判；方舟在其中保存一家人和陆地动物的代表。创世记7:17记载四十天雨水不断上涨，把方舟托起离地。

sampleVerse.text: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.

explanation.en: Mark, also called John Mark, was a Jerusalem believer, cousin of Barnabas, missionary coworker, and traditional author of the second Gospel. Acts 12:12 identifies his mother's house as a place where believers gathered to pray for imprisoned Peter.
explanation.zh: 马可又称约翰马可，是耶路撒冷信徒、巴拿巴的表亲、宣教同工，传统认为他写了第二卷福音书。使徒行传12:12称他母亲的家为信徒聚集、为被囚彼得祷告的地方。

sampleVerse.text: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.

explanation.en: Hail is frozen precipitation that can devastate crops, animals, and buildings. Exodus 9:23 records thunder, fire, and hail striking Egypt in the seventh plague after Pharaoh again resisted God's command.
explanation.zh: 冰雹是冻结的降水，能够摧毁庄稼、牲畜和建筑。出埃及记9:23记载法老再次抗拒上帝命令后，第七灾以雷、火和冰雹击打埃及。

sampleVerse.text: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.

explanation.en: The olive is a hardy Mediterranean tree whose fruit supplies oil for food, light, anointing, and sanctuary use. Genesis 8:11 records a dove returning to Noah with a fresh olive leaf, showing that floodwaters were receding from the land.
explanation.zh: 橄榄是耐旱的地中海树木，果实出油，用于食物、照明、膏抹和圣所。创世记8:11记载鸽子叼着新拧下的橄榄叶回到挪亚那里，表明洪水正从地上消退。

sampleVerse.text: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

explanation.en: A virgin is a woman who has not had sexual relations; the term also appears figuratively for peoples or cities. Isaiah 7:14 promises a virgin conceiving a son called Immanuel, a sign the New Testament identifies with Jesus' birth.
explanation.zh: 童女是未曾发生性关系的女子；这个词也可比喻民族或城市。以赛亚书7:14应许童女怀孕生子，名为以马内利；新约把这兆头认定在耶稣降生中应验。

sampleVerse.text: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

explanation.en: Clay is moldable earth used by a potter for vessels, bricks, tablets, and seals. Jeremiah 18:6 compares Israel to clay in God's hand, emphasizing the Creator's authority to reshape a marred vessel in response to repentance or rebellion.
explanation.zh: 泥是可塑的土，陶匠用它制作器皿，也可制砖、书版和印封。耶利米书18:6把以色列比作上帝手中的泥，强调创造主有权按悔改或悖逆重新塑造损坏的器皿。

sampleVerse.text: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.

explanation.en: Judas Iscariot was one of the Twelve who betrayed Jesus to the chief priests for payment. Matthew 26:14 records him initiating the arrangement, showing that privileged closeness to Christ did not remove freedom or responsibility.
explanation.zh: 加略人犹大是十二使徒之一，却为金钱把耶稣出卖给祭司长。马太福音26:14记载他主动前去商议，显示亲近基督的特权并不会取消人的自由与责任。

sampleVerse.text: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,

explanation.en: Charity in the KJV usually translates agape, meaning self-giving love rather than almsgiving alone. First Corinthians 13:13 places it with faith and hope and calls love the greatest because it shapes every Christian gift and action.
explanation.zh: KJV 的 Charity 通常翻译 agape，意为舍己的爱，并不只指慈善施舍。哥林多前书13:13把它与信心、盼望并列，又称爱最大，因为爱塑造一切基督徒恩赐与行动。

sampleVerse.text: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

explanation.en: The cross was a Roman instrument of execution and became the central Christian sign of Christ's substitutionary death and victory over sin. Galatians 6:14 rejects boasting in human status and boasts only in Jesus Christ's cross, through which the world's claims lose their rule.
explanation.zh: 十字架原是罗马刑具，后来成为基督代替人受死并战胜罪恶的核心基督教记号。加拉太书6:14拒绝夸耀人的身份，只夸耶稣基督的十字架；借此，世界的权势不再辖制人。

sampleVerse.text: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

explanation.en: Justice gives what is right, protects the vulnerable, and judges wrongdoing without favoritism. Psalm 89:14 says justice and judgment are the foundation of God's throne while mercy and truth go before him, holding righteousness and compassion together.
explanation.zh: 公义按正直施行，保护弱者，并不偏不倚地审判罪恶。诗篇89:14说公义和公平是上帝宝座的根基，慈爱和诚实行在祂前面，把正直与怜悯结合起来。

sampleVerse.text: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

explanation.en: Hebrew is an ethnic and linguistic name used for Abraham's descendants, especially when distinguished from surrounding peoples. Exodus 1:15 calls Shiphrah and Puah Hebrew midwives before they defy Pharaoh's command to kill male infants.
explanation.zh: 希伯来是用于亚伯拉罕后裔的族群和语言名称，尤其在与周围民族区分时使用。出埃及记1:15称施弗拉和普阿为希伯来收生婆；她们随后拒绝法老杀害男婴的命令。

sampleVerse.text: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

explanation.en: Joel son of Pethuel was a prophet who interpreted a devastating locust plague and announced the day of the LORD, repentance, and restoration. Joel 2:28 promises God's Spirit poured upon all kinds of people, the prophecy Peter cites at Pentecost.
explanation.zh: 毗土珥的儿子约珥是先知，借严重蝗灾宣讲耶和华的日子、悔改和复兴。约珥书2:28应许上帝的灵浇灌各类人；彼得在五旬节引用了这项预言。

sampleVerse.text: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:

explanation.en: Calling is God's summons into salvation, holiness, service, or a particular responsibility. Second Timothy 1:9 says the holy calling rests on God's purpose and grace rather than human works, while still directing the saved life toward holiness.
explanation.zh: 呼召是上帝召人进入救恩、圣洁、事奉或特定责任。提摩太后书1:9说圣召建立在上帝的旨意和恩典上，不靠人的行为，同时仍把得救的生命指向圣洁。

sampleVerse.text: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

explanation.en: Leaven is fermented dough used to make a new batch rise, so a small amount spreads its influence through the whole. First Corinthians 5:6 uses that process to warn that tolerated sin can permeate an entire congregation.
explanation.zh: 酵是发酵的面团，用来使新面团膨起；少量便能把影响扩散到全部。哥林多前书5:6用这个过程警告，被容忍的罪会渗透整个教会。

sampleVerse.text: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?

explanation.en: A mystery in the New Testament is a divine purpose once hidden but now revealed, not a puzzle meant to remain unknowable. Colossians 1:27 identifies the revealed mystery among the Gentiles as Christ in believers, the hope of glory.
explanation.zh: 新约中的奥秘是从前隐藏、如今由上帝启示的旨意，并非注定无法认识的谜题。歌罗西书1:27说明向外邦人显明的奥秘，就是基督在信徒里面成为荣耀的盼望。

sampleVerse.text: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

explanation.en: A proverb is a compact saying that compares, observes, and teaches practical wisdom for life under God. Proverbs 1:1 introduces the collection as proverbs of Solomon son of David, before stating their purpose in wisdom and disciplined understanding.
explanation.zh: 箴言是简洁的格言，借比较和观察教导人在上帝面前生活的实际智慧。箴言1:1把这部选集介绍为大卫之子所罗门的箴言，随后说明其目的在于智慧和受教的悟性。

sampleVerse.text: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

explanation.en: The dove is a gentle bird used for sacrifice by the poor and as an image of innocence, love, and the Holy Spirit's descent. Genesis 8:11 records the dove returning to Noah with an olive leaf, evidence that habitable land was emerging after the flood.
explanation.zh: 鸽子性情温和，穷人可用它献祭，也象征纯真、爱情和圣灵降临。创世记8:11记载鸽子叼着橄榄叶回到挪亚那里，证明洪水后可居住的土地正在显露。

sampleVerse.text: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

explanation.en: An idol is an image or created thing given the trust, worship, or ultimate loyalty due to God alone. Exodus 20:4 forbids making an image for worship, protecting the Creator-creature distinction at the heart of the Ten Commandments.
explanation.zh: 偶像是受造的形像或事物，却被人给予只应归上帝的信靠、敬拜或终极忠诚。出埃及记20:4禁止制造用来敬拜的形像，维护十诫核心中创造主与受造物的区分。

sampleVerse.text: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

explanation.en: To hallow is to treat as holy, set apart, and honor with reverence rather than make something morally holy by human power. Matthew 6:9 begins Jesus' model prayer by asking that the Father's name be hallowed.
explanation.zh: 尊为圣就是以圣洁、分别和敬畏对待，并不是靠人的能力使上帝的名变得更圣洁。马太福音6:9以求父的名被尊为圣，开始耶稣所教导的祷告。

sampleVerse.text: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

explanation.en: A saint is a person called and set apart for God through Christ; the New Testament applies the term broadly to faithful believers. Romans 1:7 addresses the believers in Rome as called saints, grounding holiness in God's grace and vocation.
explanation.zh: 圣徒是借基督蒙召、分别归给上帝的人；新约广泛用这个称呼指忠心的信徒。罗马书1:7称罗马信徒为蒙召作圣徒的人，把圣洁建立在上帝的恩典和呼召上。

sampleVerse.text: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

explanation.en: Greek can mean an ethnic Greek or, more broadly in New Testament contrasts, a Gentile rather than a Jew. Galatians 3:28 says Jew and Greek share equal standing in Christ, without erasing their real cultural identities.
explanation.zh: 希腊人可以指希腊族人；在新约的对比中，也可泛指与犹太人相对的外邦人。加拉太书3:28说犹太人和希腊人在基督里地位同等，同时并不抹去真实的文化身份。

sampleVerse.text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

explanation.en: Hosea son of Beeri was a prophet to northern Israel whose marriage became a lived sign of covenant unfaithfulness and persistent divine love. Hosea 1:2 begins that difficult prophetic sign-act as God confronts the land's spiritual adultery.
explanation.zh: 备利的儿子何西阿是向北国以色列传道的先知；他的婚姻成为盟约不忠与上帝恒久之爱的生活记号。何西阿书1:2开始这项艰难的先知行动，上帝借此面对全地属灵的淫乱。

sampleVerse.text: The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing from the LORD.

explanation.en: Rabbi is a respectful Jewish title meaning my teacher or master, used for teachers of the law and frequently addressed to Jesus. John 1:38 translates the title for readers when two disciples turn from John the Baptist to follow Jesus.
explanation.zh: 拉比是犹太人尊称教师的称号，意为“我的老师”或“夫子”，也常用于称呼耶稣。约翰福音1:38在两位门徒离开施洗约翰跟从耶稣时，为读者翻译了这个称号。

sampleVerse.text: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?

explanation.en: Luke was a physician, Paul's loyal coworker, and the author of Luke and Acts, who carefully gathered testimony about Jesus and the early church. Colossians 4:14 calls him the beloved physician and sends his greeting to believers.
explanation.zh: 路加是医生、保罗忠诚的同工，也是《路加福音》和《使徒行传》的作者；他细心搜集有关耶稣和初代教会的见证。歌罗西书4:14称他为亲爱的医生，并代他向信徒问安。

sampleVerse.text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

explanation.en: A thorn is a sharp plant growth and a biblical image of pain, obstruction, curse, or persistent affliction. Second Corinthians 12:7 calls Paul's unidentified suffering a thorn in the flesh that kept him dependent on Christ's sufficient grace.
explanation.zh: 刺是植物尖锐的突起，在圣经中也象征痛苦、阻碍、咒诅或持续的患难。哥林多后书12:7把保罗未说明的苦楚称为肉体中的刺，使他不断倚靠基督够用的恩典。

sampleVerse.text: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
